title.zh: 卷二百 列傳第八十八 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春
title.en: Volume 200 Biographies 88: Yao Mo, Zhang 嵿, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun
title.raw: 卷二百 列傳第八十八 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春 Volume 200 Biographies 88: Yao Mo, Zhang 嵿, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun

sentences.zh: 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春

translations.literal: Yao Mo, Zhang Ding, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Mo; Zhang Ding; Wu Wending; Cai Tianyou; Zhan Rong; Liu Tianhe; Yang Shouli; Zhang Yue; Guo Zonggao; Zhao Shichun.

sentences.zh: 姚鏌，字英之，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Yao Mo, styled Yingzhi, was a man of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Mo, styled Yingzhi, was a native of Cixi.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 6 he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 除禮部主事，進員外郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed principal clerk of the Ministry of Rites and advanced to assistant department director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites, then promoted to assistant department director.

sentences.zh: 擢廣西提學僉事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to assistant education intendant of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to assistant education intendant of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 立宣成書院，延《五經》師以教士子。

translations.literal: He established Xuancheng Academy and invited teachers of the Five Classics to instruct scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Xuancheng Academy and invited instructors in the Five Classics to teach the students.

sentences.zh: 桂人祀山魈卓旺。

translations.literal: The people of Guangxi worshipped the mountain demon Zhuo Wang.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Guangxi worshipped the mountain spirit Zhuo Wang.

sentences.zh: 鏌毀像，俗遂變。

translations.literal: Mo destroyed the image, and custom thereupon changed.
translations.idiomatic: Mo destroyed the image, and local custom changed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 遷福建副使，未幾改督學政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Fujian as vice commissioner; before long he was reassigned to supervise educational administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Fujian as vice commissioner and soon afterward was reassigned to oversee educational affairs.

sentences.zh: 正德九年擢貴州按察使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhengde he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 9 he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年拜右副都御史，巡撫延綏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he was appointed right vice censor-in-chief and grand coordinator of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 上邊務六事，皆議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized six matters on frontier affairs; all were adopted for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted six proposals on frontier affairs, and all were approved for implementation.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，吉囊入涇陽。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing, Jirong entered Jingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 1, Jirong invaded Jingyang.

sentences.zh: 鏌遣遊擊彭楧出西路，釋指揮卜雲于獄，使副之。

translations.literal: Mo sent mobile commander Peng Yuan out by the western route, released commander Bu Yun from prison, and had him serve as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Mo sent mobile commander Peng Yuan by the western route, released Commander Bu Yun from prison, and appointed him as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 夜半邀擊，斬其二將，乃遁。

translations.literal: At midnight they ambushed and beheaded two of the enemy generals; the raiders then fled.
translations.idiomatic: They launched a midnight ambush, beheaded two enemy generals, and the raiders then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 璽書褒諭。

translations.literal: An imperial edict in the emperor's own hand praised him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent a personal edict commending him.

sentences.zh: 尋召為工部右侍郎，出督漕運，改兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as right vice minister of Works, sent out to oversee the Grand Canal transport, and transferred to left vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon summoned as right vice minister of Works, sent out to supervise the grain transport system, and then transferred to left vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷右都御史，提督兩廣軍務兼巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to right censor-in-chief, with overall command of Guangdong-Guangxi military affairs while also serving as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he was promoted to right censor-in-chief, placed in overall command of Guangdong-Guangxi military affairs, and also appointed grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 田州土官岑猛謀不軌。

translations.literal: Tianzhou native official Cen Meng plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Meng, the native official of Tianzhou, plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鏌調永順、保靖兵，使沈希儀與張經、李璋、張佑、程鑒各統兵八萬，分道討。

translations.literal: Mo mobilized troops from Yongshun and Baojing and had Shen Xiyi together with Zhang Jing, Li Zhang, Zhang You, and Cheng Jian each command eighty thousand men to attack by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Mo mobilized the Yongshun and Baojing forces and had Shen Xiyi, Zhang Jing, Li Zhang, Zhang You, and Cheng Jian each lead eighty thousand troops in a multi-pronged campaign.

sentences.zh: 而鏌與總兵官硃麒等攻破定羅、丹梁。

translations.literal: Mo, together with regional commander Zhu Qi and others, captured Dingluo and Danliang.
translations.idiomatic: Mo himself, together with regional commander Zhu Qi and others, took Dingluo and Danliang.

sentences.zh: 用希儀計，結猛婦翁岑璋使為內應，大破之，斬猛子邦彥。

translations.literal: Using Shen Xiyi's plan, he won over Meng's father-in-law Cen Zhang as an inside collaborator, routed them decisively, and beheaded Meng's son Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Following Shen Xiyi's plan, he secured Meng's father-in-law Cen Zhang as an inside ally, inflicted a crushing defeat, and beheaded Meng's son Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 璋誘殺猛，獻其首。

translations.literal: Zhang lured and killed Meng and presented his head.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang lured Meng to his death and presented his head.

sentences.zh: 詔進鏌左都御史，加太子少保，任一子官，諸將進秩有差。

translations.literal: An edict promoted Mo to left censor-in-chief, added the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted office to one son, and advanced the generals in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Mo to left censor-in-chief, conferred on him the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted office to one of his sons, and advanced the generals in rank to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 鏌請改設流官，陳善後七事，制可。

translations.literal: Mo requested replacing native officials with regular appointees and presented seven measures for consolidation; the throne approved.
translations.idiomatic: Mo asked that native offices be replaced with regular officials and submitted seven proposals for postwar consolidation; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 乃命參議汪必東、僉事申惠與參將張經以兵萬人鎮其地。

translations.literal: The court then ordered participating secretaries Wang Bidong and Shen Hui, together with assistant regional commander Zhang Jing, to garrison the region with ten thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered participating secretary Wang Bidong, assistant commissioner Shen Hui, and assistant regional commander Zhang Jing to garrison the area with ten thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 必東、惠移疾他駐。

translations.literal: Wang Bidong and Shen Hui claimed illness and relocated elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bidong and Shen Hui pleaded illness and moved their garrisons elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 猛党盧蘇、王受等詐言猛不死，借交阯兵二十萬且至，夷民信之。

translations.literal: Meng's followers Lu Su, Wang Shou, and others falsely claimed Meng was not dead and that two hundred thousand Annam troops were about to arrive; the tribal peoples believed it.
translations.idiomatic: Meng's partisans Lu Su, Wang Shou, and others spread the false report that Meng was still alive and that two hundred thousand Annamese troops were on their way; the tribal peoples believed them.

sentences.zh: 蘇等薄城，經突圍走，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Lu and his fellows pressed the city; Zhang Jing broke out and fled, and the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: Lu and his men pressed the city; Zhang Jing broke out and fled, and the city was lost.

sentences.zh: 王受亦攻入思恩府。

translations.literal: Wang Shou also attacked and took Sien Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shou also attacked and captured Sien Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史石金劾鏌失策罔上，並論前總督盛應期。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Shi Jin impeached Mo for misjudgment and deceiving the throne, and also criticized the former overall commander Sheng Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Shi Jin impeached Mo for strategic failure and deceiving the throne, and also criticized the former supreme commander Sheng Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 帝以鏌有功，許便宜撫剿。

translations.literal: The emperor considered that Mo had merit and permitted him discretionary authority to pacify and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Mo still had merit and allowed him discretionary authority to pacify or suppress as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 蘇、受數求赦，鏌不許，將大討之。

translations.literal: Lu and Wang repeatedly sought pardon; Mo refused and was about to mount a major campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Lu and Wang repeatedly petitioned for amnesty, but Mo refused and was preparing a major punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 會廷議起王守仁督兩廣軍，令鏌與同事。

translations.literal: The court then decided to recall Wang Shouren to command Guangdong-Guangxi forces and ordered Mo to serve jointly with him.
translations.idiomatic: The court then resolved to recall Wang Shouren to command the Guangdong-Guangxi armies and ordered Mo to serve alongside him.

sentences.zh: 鏌引疾乞罷，許馳驛歸。

translations.literal: Mo pleaded illness and asked to be relieved; he was permitted to return by urgent courier post.
translations.idiomatic: Mo pleaded illness and asked to be relieved of duty; he was permitted to return home by express relay.

sentences.zh: 初，廣東提學道魏校毀諸寺觀田數千畝，盡入霍韜、方獻夫諸家。

translations.literal: Earlier, Guangdong education intendant Wei Xiao had confiscated thousands of mu of temple and monastery lands, all of which passed into the households of Huo Tao, Fang Xianfu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Guangdong education intendant Wei Xiao had seized thousands of mu of temple and monastery land, all of which ended up in the hands of Huo Tao, Fang Xianfu, and their allies.

sentences.zh: 鏌至廣，追還之官。

translations.literal: When Mo reached Guangdong, he recovered them for the state.
translations.idiomatic: When Mo arrived in Guangdong, he recovered the land for the government.

sentences.zh: 韜、獻夫恨甚，與張璁、桂萼合排鏌。

translations.literal: Huo and Fang hated him bitterly and joined Zhang Cong and Gui E in attacking Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Huo and Fang resented him deeply and joined Zhang Cong and Gui E in a concerted attack on Mo.

sentences.zh: 謂大同當征而反撫，田州當撫而反征，皆費宏謀國不臧，釀成南北患。

translations.literal: They charged that where Datong should have been conquered he had instead pacified, and where Tianzhou should have been pacified he had instead campaigned—all due to Fei Hong's unsound statecraft, which had brewed calamities north and south.
translations.idiomatic: They charged that where Datong should have been fought he had chosen to pacify, and where Tianzhou should have been pacified he had chosen to fight—all fruits of Fei Hong's unsound governance, which had bred disasters in both north and south.

sentences.zh: 時宏雖去，猶借鏌以排之也。

translations.literal: Though Hong was already gone, they still used Mo to strike at him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Hong was already out of office, they still used Mo to attack him by implication.

sentences.zh: 鏌既得請，方候代，千夫長韋貴、徐伍攻復思恩。

translations.literal: After Mo's request was granted, while he was awaiting his successor, company commanders Wei Gui and Xu Wu attacked and recovered Sien.
translations.idiomatic: After Mo's request for relief was granted, while he was awaiting his successor, company commanders Wei Gui and Xu Wu attacked and recovered Sien.

sentences.zh: 鏌上其狀。

translations.literal: Mo reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Mo reported this to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔先賞貴等，而以撫剿事宜俟守仁處置。

translations.literal: An edict first rewarded Wei and the others, but left pacification and suppression to Wang Shouren's discretion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict first rewarded Wei and the others, but left questions of pacification and suppression to Wang Shouren's judgment.

sentences.zh: 既而鏌奏辯石金前疏，詆金阻撓養寇。

translations.literal: Mo then memorialized in rebuttal of Shi's earlier memorial, accusing Shi of obstruction and nurturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Mo then submitted a memorial rebutting Shi's earlier accusation, charging Shi with obstruction and with nurturing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 金亦再疏詆鏌。

translations.literal: Shi also memorialized again to denounce Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Shi likewise submitted another memorial denouncing Mo.

sentences.zh: 帝先入璁等言，落鏌職閑住。

translations.literal: The emperor, having already been swayed by Zhang Cong and the others, stripped Mo of office and ordered him to live in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, having already been persuaded by Zhang Cong and his allies, stripped Mo of office and ordered him to live in retirement.

sentences.zh: 其後，蘇、受復叛，帝漸思鏌。

translations.literal: Later, when Lu and Wang rebelled again, the emperor gradually came to miss Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Lu and Wang rebelled again, the emperor gradually came to regret dismissing Mo.

sentences.zh: 十三年，三邊闕總制。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the three-frontier supreme command was vacant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the supreme command over the three frontiers fell vacant.

sentences.zh: 大學士費宏、李時同召對。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries Fei Hong and Li Shi were summoned together for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretaries Fei Hong and Li Shi were summoned together for an audience.

sentences.zh: 宏薦鏌，時亦助之。

translations.literal: Hong recommended Mo, and Shi also supported him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong recommended Mo, and Shi seconded the recommendation.

sentences.zh: 遂命以兵部尚書總制三邊軍務。

translations.literal: Mo was then ordered appointed Minister of War with overall command of the three-frontier military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mo was accordingly ordered to take up the post of Minister of War with overall command of military affairs on the three frontiers.

sentences.zh: 未赴，宏卒。

translations.literal: Before he could take up the post, Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the appointment, Hong died.

sentences.zh: 鏌辭。

translations.literal: Mo declined.
translations.idiomatic: Mo declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅，仍落職閑住。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased and again stripped him of office for retirement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased and again stripped him of office, ordering him to live in retirement.

sentences.zh: 鏌既罷，薦者至二十疏，不用。

translations.literal: After Mo was dismissed, recommenders submitted as many as twenty memorials, but he was not employed.
translations.idiomatic: After Mo was dismissed, as many as twenty recommendation memorials were submitted on his behalf, but he was not reappointed.

sentences.zh: 家居數年卒。

translations.literal: He lived at home for several years and then died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for several years and then died.

sentences.zh: 子淶，字維東。

translations.literal: His son Lai, styled Weidong.
translations.idiomatic: His son Lai, styled Weidong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年殿試第一。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing he placed first in the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 2 he placed first in the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 授翰林修撰。

translations.literal: He was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Hanlin Academician Expositor.

sentences.zh: 爭「大禮」，廷杖。

translations.literal: He disputed the Grand Rites controversy and was beaten in court.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the dispute over the Grand Rites and was beaten in court.

sentences.zh: 又議郊祀合祀，不當輕易。

translations.literal: He also argued that combined suburban sacrifices should not be changed lightly.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that the merger of suburban sacrifices should not be undertaken lightly.

sentences.zh: 召修《明倫大典》，懇辭不與。

translations.literal: Summoned to compile the Great Canon of Ming Ethics, he earnestly declined and did not participate.
translations.idiomatic: When summoned to compile the Great Canon of Ming Ethics, he earnestly declined and did not take part.

sentences.zh: 累官侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He rose through posts to Reader-in-waiting of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to Reader-in-waiting of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 張嵿，字時俊，蕭山人。

translations.literal: Zhang Ding, styled Shijun, was a man of Xiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ding, styled Shijun, was a native of Xiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 成化二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Chenghua he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 23 he passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 弘治初，修《憲宗實錄》，命往蘇、松諸府采軼事。

translations.literal: Early in Hongzhi, while compiling the Veritable Records of Xianzong, he was ordered to go to Suzhou, Songjiang, and other prefectures to collect overlooked matters.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Hongzhi reign, while compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Xianzong, he was sent to Suzhou, Songjiang, and other prefectures to gather overlooked material.

sentences.zh: 事竣，授上饒知縣。

translations.literal: When the work was finished, he was appointed magistrate of Shangrao.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was completed, he was appointed magistrate of Shangrao.

sentences.zh: 遷南京兵部主事，就進刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of War and advanced in place to director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of War and was soon promoted in place to director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 正德初，遷興化知府。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengde he was transferred to prefect of Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he was transferred to prefect of Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 隆平侯張祐無子，弟祿與族人爭襲，訴于南京法司，久不決，復訴京師。

translations.literal: Marquis Longping Zhang You had no son; his younger brother Lu and clan members disputed the succession, appealed to the Nanjing judiciary, and after long indecision appealed again to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Longping Zhang You had no son; his younger brother Lu and kinsmen disputed the succession, appealed to the Nanjing judiciary, and after long delay appealed again to the capital.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾方擅政，遂削尚書樊瑩、都御史高銓籍。

translations.literal: Liu Jin was then dominating government and stripped Minister Fan Ying and Censor-in-chief Gao Quan of their registers.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin was then in control of the government and stripped Minister Fan Ying and Censor-in-chief Gao Quan of their official standing.

sentences.zh: 嵿以郎承勘，為民。

translations.literal: Ding as a director undertook the investigation and was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Ding, as the investigating director, took on the case and was himself reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 瑾敗，起知南雄。

translations.literal: After Jin's fall he was restored and appointed magistrate of Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin's fall he was restored to office and appointed magistrate of Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 擢江西參政，進右布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Jiangxi administration commissioner and advanced to right provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to administration commissioner of Jiangxi and then to right provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 舉治行卓異，遷左。

translations.literal: Cited for outstanding governance, he was transferred to the left commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: Cited for outstanding administrative performance, he was transferred to the left commissionership.

sentences.zh: 甯王宸濠欲拓地，廣其居，嵿執不可。

translations.literal: Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao wished to expand his lands and enlarge his residence; Ding would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Ning, Zhu Chenhao, wished to seize more land and enlarge his residence; Ding refused to allow it.

sentences.zh: 大恚，遣人饋之。

translations.literal: Chenhao was furious and sent someone to present gifts to him.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Chenhao sent someone to present him with gifts.

sentences.zh: 嵿發視，則棗梨姜芥，蓋隱語也。

translations.literal: When Ding opened them, they were jujubes, pears, ginger, and mustard—a covert insult.
translations.idiomatic: When Ding opened the parcel, he found jujubes, pears, ginger, and mustard—a veiled curse by homophonic wordplay.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召為光祿卿。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned as Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned to serve as Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 以右副都御史巡撫保定諸府，忤中貴，移疾歸。

translations.literal: As right vice censor-in-chief he grand-coordinated the Baoding prefectures; he offended palace eunuchs and retired on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed right vice censor-in-chief to grand-coordinate the Baoding prefectures, he offended powerful eunuchs and retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 伍文定，字時泰，松滋人。

translations.literal: Wu Wending, styled Shitai, was a man of Songzi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Wending, styled Shitai, was a native of Songzi.

sentences.zh: 父琇，貴州參議。

translations.literal: His father Xiu was administration commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xiu had served as administration commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 文定登弘治十二年進士。

translations.literal: Wending passed the jinshi in the twelfth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Wending passed the jinshi examination in Hongzhi year 12.

sentences.zh: 有膂力，便弓馬，議論慷慨。

translations.literal: He had a powerful physique, was skilled at archery and horsemanship, and spoke with fervor.
translations.idiomatic: He was powerfully built, skilled at archery and horsemanship, and spoke with passionate conviction.

sentences.zh: 授常州推官，精敏善決獄，稱強吏。

translations.literal: Appointed investigating commissioner of Changzhou, he was sharp and skilled at adjudication and was called a formidable official.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed investigating commissioner of Changzhou, he was acute and decisive in judgment and was known as a formidable magistrate.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐俌與民爭田，文定勘，歸之民。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei State Xu Si contended with commoners over fields; Wending investigated and restored the land to the people.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke of Wei Xu Si disputed land with commoners, Wending investigated the case and restored the fields to the people.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾入俌重賄，興大獄，巡撫艾朴以下十四人悉被逮。

translations.literal: Liu Jin accepted heavy bribes from Xu Si and launched a major case; grand coordinator Ai Pu and fourteen others below were all arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin accepted heavy bribes from Xu Si and launched a major prosecution; grand coordinator Ai Pu and fourteen others were all arrested.

sentences.zh: 文定已遷成都同知，亦下詔獄，斥為民。

translations.literal: Wending had already been transferred to vice prefect of Chengdu; he too was cast into the imperial prison and reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Wending had already been transferred to vice prefect of Chengdu, but he too was thrown into the imperial prison and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 瑾敗，起補嘉興。

translations.literal: After Jin's fall he was restored and appointed to Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin's fall he was restored to office and appointed magistrate of Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 江西姚源賊王浩八等流劫浙江開化，都御史俞諫檄文定與參將李隆、都指揮江洪、僉事儲珊討之，軍華埠。

translations.literal: Wang Haoba and other Yaoyuan bandits of Jiangxi raided Kaihua in Zhejiang; Censor-in-chief Yu Jian ordered Wending together with Regional Vice Commander Li Long, Commander-in-chief Jiang Hong, and Assistant Commissioner Chu Shan to campaign against them, encamping at Huabu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Haoba and other Yaoyuan bandits from Jiangxi raided Kaihua in Zhejiang; Censor-in-chief Yu Jian ordered Wending, together with regional vice commander Li Long, commander-in-chief Jiang Hong, and assistant commissioner Chu Shan, to suppress them, and they encamped at Huabu.

sentences.zh: 而都指揮白弘與湖州知府黃衷別營馬金。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief Bai Hong and Huzhou prefect Huang Zhong separately encamped at Majin.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Bai Hong and Huzhou prefect Huang Zhong, however, set up a separate camp at Majin.

sentences.zh: 賊党劉昌三破，執弘，官軍大挫。

translations.literal: Bandit associate Liu Chang thrice defeated them, seized Hong, and the government forces suffered a major setback.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Liu Chang defeated them three times, captured Hong, and the government forces suffered a major defeat.

sentences.zh: 浩八突華埠，洪、文定擊敗之，追及于孔埠。

translations.literal: Haoba struck at Huabu; Hong and Wending defeated him and pursued to Kongbu.
translations.idiomatic: Haoba struck at Huabu; Hong and Wending repulsed him and pursued as far as Kongbu.

sentences.zh: 隆、珊亦追至池淮，破其巢，進攻淫田。

translations.literal: Long and Shan also pursued to Chihuai, destroyed their lair, and advanced to attack Yintian.
translations.idiomatic: Long and Shan also pursued the bandits to Chihuai, destroyed their stronghold, and advanced against Yintian.

sentences.zh: 洪以奇兵深入，中賊誘，與指揮張琳等皆被執。

translations.literal: Hong led elite troops deep in; he fell for an enemy ruse, and he together with Commander Zhang Lin and others were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Hong led a picked force deep into enemy territory, fell into an ambush, and was captured along with Commander Zhang Lin and others.

sentences.zh: 文定等殿后得還，賊亦遁歸江西。

translations.literal: Wending and the others covered the rear and got back; the bandits also fled to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wending and the others covered the retreat and got back safely; the bandits also fled into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 諫等上文定忠勇狀，詔所司獎勞。

translations.literal: Yu Jian and the others memorialized Wending's loyal valor; an edict ordered the appropriate offices to reward and comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jian and the others submitted a memorial praising Wending's loyal courage; an edict ordered the relevant offices to reward him.

sentences.zh: 擢河南知府，計擒劇賊張勇、李文簡。

translations.literal: Promoted to prefect of Henan, he devised plans and captured the major bandits Zhang Yong and Li Wenjian.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to prefect of Henan, he devised stratagems and captured the major bandits Zhang Yong and Li Wenjian.

sentences.zh: 以才任治劇，調吉安。

translations.literal: For his talent he was assigned to govern a difficult prefecture and was transferred to Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: Recognizing his talent for governing difficult jurisdictions, the court transferred him to Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 計平永豐及大茅山賊。

translations.literal: By stratagem he pacified the bandits of Yongfeng and Mount Damao.
translations.idiomatic: By stratagem he pacified the bandits of Yongfeng and Mount Damao.

sentences.zh: 已，佐巡撫王守仁平桶岡、橫水。

translations.literal: Later he assisted Grand Coordinator Wang Shouren in pacifying Tonggang and Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: He later assisted Grand Coordinator Wang Shouren in pacifying Tonggang and Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，吉安士民爭亡匿。

translations.literal: When Chenhao rebelled, the gentry and commoners of Ji'an scrambled to flee and hide.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenhao rebelled, the gentry and commoners of Ji'an scrambled to flee and hide.

sentences.zh: 文定斬亡者一人，眾乃定。

translations.literal: Wending beheaded one fugitive, and the multitude was thereby stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: Wending beheaded one man who tried to flee, and the people were thereby steadied.

sentences.zh: 乃迎守仁入城。

translations.literal: He then welcomed Shouren into the city.
translations.idiomatic: He then welcomed Shouren into the city.

sentences.zh: 知府邢珣、徐璉、戴德孺等先後至，共討賊。

translations.literal: Prefects Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others arrived in succession to campaign against the rebels together.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others arrived one after another, and together they marched against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 文定當大帥。

translations.literal: Wending served as chief commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wending served as the chief commander.

sentences.zh: 丙辰之戰，身犯矢石、火燎須不動。

translations.literal: In the battle on the bingchen day he exposed himself to arrows and stones; though fire scorched his beard he did not stir.
translations.idiomatic: In the battle on the bingchen day he exposed himself to arrows and stones; though fire scorched his beard, he did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 賊平，功最，擢江西按察使。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified his merit was greatest; he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified, his merit ranked first, and he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 張忠、許泰至南昌，欲冒其功，而守仁已俘宸濠赴浙江。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhong and Xu Tai reached Nanchang wishing to claim the credit, but Shouren had already captured Chenhao and was proceeding to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhong and Xu Tai reached Nanchang intending to steal the credit, but Shouren had already captured Chenhao and was escorting him to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 忠等失望，大恨。

translations.literal: Zhong and the others were disappointed and deeply resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong and his party were disappointed and filled with hatred.

sentences.zh: 文定出謁，遂縛之。

translations.literal: When Wending came out to pay his respects, they bound him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wending came out to pay his respects, they bound him on the spot.

sentences.zh: 文定罵曰：「吾不恤九族，為國家平大賊，何罪？

translations.literal: Wending cursed them, saying: "I cared not for my nine degrees of kin in pacifying a great rebel for the state—what crime is that?
translations.idiomatic: Wending cursed them, saying, "I did not spare my own kin in order to pacify a great rebel for the state—what crime is that?

sentences.zh: 汝天子腹心，屈辱忠義，為逆賊報仇，法當斬。

translations.literal: You are the Son of Heaven's intimate retainers, yet you humiliate loyal righteousness and avenge rebels—by law you ought to be beheaded."
translations.idiomatic: You are the Son of Heaven's closest retainers, yet you humiliate loyal men and avenge rebels—by law you deserve execution."

sentences.zh: 」忠益怒，椎文定僕地。

translations.literal: Zhong grew angrier still and clubbed Wending to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong grew even angrier and clubbed Wending to the ground.

sentences.zh: 文定求解任，不報。

translations.literal: Wending requested to be relieved; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Wending asked to be relieved of duty, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 尋遷廣東右布政使。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to right provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to right provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 未赴，而世宗嗣位。

translations.literal: Before he could take up the post, Shizong succeeded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the appointment, Emperor Shizong succeeded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上忠等罪狀，且曰：「曩忠、泰與劉暉至江西，忠自稱天子弟，暉稱天子兒，泰稱威武副將軍，與天子同僚。

translations.literal: He memorialized the crimes of Zhong and the others, saying: "Formerly Zhong and Tai, together with Liu Hui, came to Jiangxi; Zhong called himself the Son of Heaven's younger brother, Hui called himself the Son of Heaven's son, and Tai called himself Vice General of Might and Prestige, the Son of Heaven's peer."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial detailing the crimes of Zhong and the others, saying, "When Zhong and Tai came to Jiangxi with Liu Hui, Zhong called himself the emperor's younger brother, Hui called himself the emperor's son, and Tai styled himself Vice General of Might and Prestige, claiming to be the emperor's equal."

sentences.zh: 折辱命吏，誣害良民。

translations.literal: They insulted commissioned officials and falsely harmed good commoners.
translations.idiomatic: They insulted commissioned officials and falsely persecuted innocent people.

sentences.zh: 需求萬端，漁獵盈百萬。

translations.literal: Their exactions were endless and their plunder exceeded a million.
translations.idiomatic: Their exactions were endless, and their plunder exceeded a million.

sentences.zh: 致餓殍遍野，盜賊縱橫。

translations.literal: They left corpses of starvation across the fields and bandits running rampant.
translations.idiomatic: They left the fields strewn with the starved dead and bandits running rampant.

sentences.zh: 雖寸斬三人，不足謝江西百姓。

translations.literal: Even slicing the three men inch by inch would not suffice to answer to the people of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the three were cut to pieces inch by inch, it would not be enough to answer to the people of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 今大憝江彬、強尼皆已伏法，三人實其黨與。

translations.literal: Now the great criminals Jiang Bin and Qian Ning have both been executed; these three were in fact their accomplices.
translations.idiomatic: Now the great criminals Jiang Bin and Qian Ning have both been executed; these three were in fact their accomplices.

sentences.zh: 乞速正天誅，用章國典。

translations.literal: I beg that heavenly punishment be quickly carried out to manifest the national statutes."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that they be swiftly punished by law to uphold the statutes of the realm."

sentences.zh: 」又請發宸濠資財，還之江西，以資經費；

translations.literal: He also asked that Chenhao's assets be disbursed and returned to Jiangxi to fund expenses;
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Chenhao's assets be disbursed and returned to Jiangxi to fund public expenses;

sentences.zh: 矜釋忠、泰所陷無辜及甯府宗人不預謀者，以清冤獄。

translations.literal: and that innocents framed by Zhong and Tai and Ning princely clansmen who had not joined the plot be shown mercy to clear wrongful prisons.
translations.idiomatic: and that innocents framed by Zhong and Tai, together with Ning princely clansmen who had not joined the plot, be shown mercy in order to clear wrongful imprisonments.

sentences.zh: 帝並嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 論功，進右副都御史，提督操江。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to right vice censor-in-chief with command of the Caojiang defense.
translations.idiomatic: In recognition of his merit he was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and placed in command of the Caojiang defense.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年，討獲海賊董效等二百餘人，賜敕獎勞。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiajing he captured more than two hundred pirates including Dong Xiao and was granted an imperial edict of reward.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 3 he captured more than two hundred sea bandits including Dong Xiao and was rewarded with an imperial edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 尋謝病歸。

translations.literal: Soon he retired on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 六年召拜兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was summoned as right vice minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he was summoned to serve as right vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 其冬擢右都御史，代胡世寧掌院事。

translations.literal: That winter he was promoted to right censor-in-chief to replace Hu Shining in directing the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was promoted to right censor-in-chief to replace Hu Shining as head of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 雲南士酋安銓反，敗參政黃昭道，攻陷尋甸、嵩明。

translations.literal: The Yunnan tribal chief An Quan rebelled, defeated Administration Vice Commissioner Huang Zhaodao, and captured Xundian and Songming.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan tribal chief An Quan rebelled, defeated administration vice commissioner Huang Zhaodao, and captured Xundian and Songming.

sentences.zh: 明年，武定土酋鳳朝文亦反，殺同知以下官，與銓合兵圍雲南。

translations.literal: The next year Wuding tribal chief Feng Chaowen also rebelled, killed officials below the rank of sub-prefect, and joined forces with Quan to besiege Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Wuding tribal chief Feng Chaowen also rebelled, killed officials below the rank of sub-prefect, and joined forces with Quan to besiege Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 詔進文定兵部尚書兼前職，提督雲南、四川、貴州、湖廣軍討之，以侍郎梁材督餉。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Wending to Minister of War while retaining his former duties, with command over armies of Yunnan, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang to suppress them; Vice Minister Liang Cai supervised supplies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Wending to Minister of War while retaining his former duties, placed him in overall command of the armies of Yunnan, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang to suppress them, and appointed Vice Minister Liang Cai to supervise supplies.

sentences.zh: 會芒部叛酋沙保子普奴為亂，並以屬文定。

translations.literal: At the same time Mangbu rebel chief Shabao's son Pulu rose in revolt; this too was assigned to Wending.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Pulu, son of the Mangbu rebel chief Shabao, rose in revolt, and this campaign was also assigned to Wending.

sentences.zh: 文定未至雲南，銓等已為巡撫歐陽重所破，遂移師征普奴。

translations.literal: Before Wending reached Yunnan, Quan and the others had already been defeated by Grand Coordinator Ouyang Chong; he therefore shifted his army to campaign against Pulu.
translations.idiomatic: Before Wending reached Yunnan, Quan and his followers had already been defeated by Grand Coordinator Ouyang Chong, so he shifted his army to campaign against Pulu.

sentences.zh: 左都御史李承勳極言川、貴殘破，不當用兵，遂召還，命提督京營。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-chief Li Chengxun vehemently argued that Sichuan and Guizhou were ruined and war should not be waged; Wending was recalled and ordered to command the capital barracks.
translations.idiomatic: Left censor-in-chief Li Chengxun argued forcefully that Sichuan and Guizhou were too devastated for war; Wending was recalled and ordered to command the capital barracks.

sentences.zh: 文定至湖廣，疏乞省祭歸。

translations.literal: When Wending reached Huguang he memorialized asking leave to return home for ancestral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When Wending reached Huguang, he memorialized asking leave to return home for ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 已，四川巡按御史戴金復上言：「叛酋稱亂之初，勢尚可撫。

translations.literal: Later Sichuan investigating censor Dai Jin again memorialized: "When the rebel chiefs first rose, their strength could still have been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Sichuan investigating censor Dai Jin submitted another memorial, saying, "When the rebel chiefs first rose, their strength could still have been pacified.

sentences.zh: 而文定決意進兵，一無顧惜。

translations.literal: Yet Wending resolved to advance troops without the slightest regard.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Wending resolved to advance troops without the slightest regard for consequences.

sentences.zh: 飛芻挽糧，糜數十萬。

translations.literal: He rushed grain by forced transport, squandering hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He rushed grain forward by forced labor, squandering hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 及有詔罷師，尚不肯已。

translations.literal: Even when an edict ordered the army withdrawn, he still would not stop.
translations.idiomatic: Even after an edict ordered the troops withdrawn, he still would not stop.

sentences.zh: 又極論土酋阿濟等罪。

translations.literal: He also vehemently denounced the crimes of tribal chiefs Aji and others.
translations.idiomatic: He also vehemently denounced the crimes of tribal chiefs such as Aji.

sentences.zh: 軍民訛言，幾復生變。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians spread rumors and disorder nearly broke out again.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians spread rumors, and unrest nearly broke out again.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為文定可罪也。

translations.literal: This subject foolishly considers Wending punishable."
translations.idiomatic: This subject, in his ignorance, believes Wending deserves punishment."

sentences.zh: 」尚書方獻夫、李承勳因詆文定好大喜功，傷財動眾，乃令致仕。

translations.literal: Ministers Fang Xianfu and Li Chengxun accordingly denounced Wending for love of grand exploits, waste of resources, and disturbance of the populace; he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Fang Xianfu and Li Chengxun accordingly denounced Wending for grandstanding, wasting resources, and disturbing the populace, and he was ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 文定忠義自許，遇事敢為，不與時俯仰。

translations.literal: Wending prided himself on loyalty and righteousness, dared to act when matters arose, and would not bow with the times.
translations.idiomatic: Wending prided himself on loyalty and righteousness, dared to act decisively, and would not bend with the times.

sentences.zh: 芒部之役，憤小丑數亂，欲為國伸威，為議者旁撓。

translations.literal: In the Mangbu campaign he was angered that petty chiefs repeatedly rebelled and wished to vindicate the state's honor, but was thwarted by sideline critics.
translations.idiomatic: In the Mangbu campaign he was angered that petty chiefs repeatedly rebelled and wished to vindicate the state's authority, but was thwarted by critics on the sidelines.

sentences.zh: 廟堂專務姑息，以故功不克就。

translations.literal: The court devoted itself solely to indulgence, and for this reason his achievement could not be brought to completion.
translations.idiomatic: The court devoted itself solely to appeasement, and for this reason his achievement could not be brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 九年七月卒於家。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 9 he died at home.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，追諡忠襄。

translations.literal: Early in Tianqi he was posthumously enfeoffed with the title Loyal and Assisting.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianqi reign he was posthumously granted the title Loyal and Assisting.

sentences.zh: 邢珣，當塗人，弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: Xing Xun, a man of Dangtu, passed the jinshi in the sixth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Xun, a native of Dangtu, passed the jinshi examination in Hongzhi year 6.

sentences.zh: 正德初，曆官南京戶部郎中。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengde he served through posts to director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he rose through posts to director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 忤劉瑾，除名。

translations.literal: He offended Liu Jin and was struck from the register.
translations.idiomatic: He offended Liu Jin and was struck from the official register.

sentences.zh: 瑾誅，起南京工部，遷贛州知府。

translations.literal: After Jin was executed he was restored to the Nanjing Ministry of Works and transferred to prefect of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin was executed he was restored to the Nanjing Ministry of Works and transferred to prefect of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 招降劇盜滿總等，授廬給田，撫之甚厚。

translations.literal: He induced the major bandit Man Zong and others to surrender, granted them houses and fields, and treated them very generously.
translations.idiomatic: He induced the major bandit Man Zong and others to surrender, granted them houses and fields, and treated them with great generosity.

sentences.zh: 後討他盜，多藉其力。

translations.literal: Later in campaigns against other bandits he relied heavily on their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in campaigns against other bandits, he relied heavily on their strength.

sentences.zh: 守仁征橫水、桶岡，珣常為軍鋒。

translations.literal: When Shouren campaigned against Hengshui and Tonggang, Xun often served as army vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Shouren campaigned against Hengshui and Tonggang, Xun often served as the army vanguard.

sentences.zh: 功最，增二秩。

translations.literal: His merit was greatest and he received a two-rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: His merit ranked first, and he received a two-rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，以重賞誘總。

translations.literal: When Chenhao rebelled he tempted Zong with rich rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenhao rebelled, he tried to win Zong over with rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 總執其使送珣，遂從珣共平宸濠。

translations.literal: Zong seized Chenhao's envoy and sent him to Xun, then followed Xun to pacify Chenhao together.
translations.idiomatic: Zong seized Chenhao's envoy and sent him to Xun, then followed Xun in pacifying Chenhao.

sentences.zh: 徐璉，朝邑人。

translations.literal: Xu Lian, a man of Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Lian was a native of Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 文定同年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the same year as Wending.
translations.idiomatic: He was a jinshi of the same year as Wending.

sentences.zh: 由戶部郎中出為袁州知府。

translations.literal: From director in the Ministry of Revenue he went out as prefect of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: From a post as director in the Ministry of Revenue he went out to serve as prefect of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 從討宸濠，獲首功千餘。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Chenhao he took more than a thousand enemy heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Chenhao he took more than a thousand enemy heads.

sentences.zh: 事定，珣、璉遷江西右參政。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, Xun and Lian were transferred to right administration commissioners of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Xun and Lian were transferred to right administration commissioners of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 世宗錄功，各增秩二等。

translations.literal: Shizong recorded their merit and each received a two-rank advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong recorded their merit, and each received a two-rank advancement.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年大計，給事御史劾監司不職者二十二人，珣、璉與焉。

translations.literal: In the grand review of the second year of Jiajing, supervising secretaries and censors impeached twenty-two surveillance and administration officials for dereliction; Xun and Lian were among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the grand review of Jiajing year 2, supervising secretaries and censors impeached twenty-two surveillance and administration officials for dereliction of duty; Xun and Lian were among them.

sentences.zh: 吏部以軍功未酬，請進秩布政使致仕，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel, citing unpaid military merit, requested advancing them to administration commissioners and retirement; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel, citing unpaid military merit, requested that they be advanced to administration commissioners and allowed to retire; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 二人竟廢。

translations.literal: The two men were ultimately cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the two men were cast aside entirely.

sentences.zh: 珣子埴嘗學于張璁。

translations.literal: Xun's son Zhi had once studied under Zhang Cong.
translations.idiomatic: Xun's son Zhi had once studied under Zhang Cong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初登鄉薦。

translations.literal: Early in Jiajing he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 璁貴顯，屢欲援之，辭不應。

translations.literal: When Cong rose to prominence he repeatedly wished to support him; Zhi declined and did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong rose to power he repeatedly wished to support him, but Zhi declined and would not accept.

sentences.zh: 授浦城知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 有徐浦者，役公府。

translations.literal: There was a man named Xu Pu who served in the government office.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Xu Pu who served in the government office.

sentences.zh: 埴一見異之，令與子同學，為娶妻。

translations.literal: At first sight Zhi recognized his unusual quality, had him study with his son, and found him a wife.
translations.idiomatic: At first sight Zhi recognized his unusual talent, had him study with his son, and found him a wife.

sentences.zh: 後登第為給事中。

translations.literal: Later he passed the examinations and became a supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Later he passed the metropolitan examination and became a supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 其家世世祀埴。

translations.literal: His family worshipped Zhi generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: His family worshipped Zhi generation after generation.

sentences.zh: 弟址，進士，曆御史，終山東鹽運使。

translations.literal: Younger brother Zhi, a jinshi, served through posts as censor and ended as salt transport commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhi, a jinshi, served through posts as censor and ended his career as salt transport commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以清操聞。

translations.literal: He was known for pure integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He was known for his pure integrity.

sentences.zh: 戴德孺，臨海人。

translations.literal: Dai Deru, a man of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Deru was a native of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 弘治十八年進士。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Hongzhi year 18.

sentences.zh: 曆工部員外郎。

translations.literal: He served through posts to assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through posts to assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 監蕪湖稅，有清名。

translations.literal: Supervising the Wuhu tax, he had a reputation for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: While supervising the Wuhu tax, he earned a reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 再遷臨江知府。

translations.literal: He was twice transferred to prefect of Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，遣使收府印，德孺斬之。

translations.literal: When Chenhao rebelled he sent envoys to seize the prefectural seal; Deru beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenhao rebelled, he sent envoys to seize the prefectural seal; Deru beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 與家人誓曰：「吾死守孤城。

translations.literal: He swore to his family: "I will die defending this lone city.
translations.idiomatic: He swore to his family, "I will die defending this lone city.

sentences.zh: 脫有急，若輩沉池中，吾不負國也。

translations.literal: If danger comes, you shall sink yourselves in the pool—I will not fail the state."
translations.idiomatic: If danger comes, you are to drown yourselves in the pool—I will not fail the state."

sentences.zh: 」即日戒嚴。

translations.literal: That very day he declared martial law.
translations.idiomatic: That very day he put the city under martial law.

sentences.zh: 旋與守仁共滅宸濠。

translations.literal: He soon joined Shouren in destroying Chenhao.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Shouren in destroying Chenhao.

sentences.zh: 以憂去。

translations.literal: He left office on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 世宗以德孺馭軍最整，獨增三秩，為雲南右布政使。

translations.literal: Shizong, because Deru had disciplined his troops most strictly, alone gave him a three-rank advancement and made him right provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Because Deru had disciplined his troops most strictly, Emperor Shizong alone gave him a three-rank advancement and appointed him right provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 舟次徐州，覆水死。

translations.literal: When his boat stopped at Xuzhou he drowned in a capsize.
translations.idiomatic: When his boat stopped at Xuzhou, he drowned in a capsize.

sentences.zh: 後贈光祿寺卿，予一子官。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously granted Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and office was granted to one son.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously granted the title Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and office was granted to one of his sons.

sentences.zh: 珣、璉等倡義討賊，月余成大功。

translations.literal: Xun, Lian, and the others initiated the righteous campaign against the rebels and within little more than a month achieved great success.
translations.idiomatic: Xun, Lian, and the others took the lead in the righteous campaign against the rebels and within little more than a month achieved a great victory.

sentences.zh: 當事者以嫉守仁故，痛裁抑之。

translations.literal: Those in power, because they resented Shouren, harshly cut them down.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power, because they resented Shouren, harshly suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 或賞或否，又往往借考功法逐之去。

translations.literal: Sometimes rewarded, sometimes not, they were often driven out under the pretext of the evaluation law.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes rewarded and sometimes not, they were often driven from office under the pretext of the evaluation law.

sentences.zh: 守仁之再疏辭爵也，為諸人訟曰：

translations.literal: When Shouren twice memorialized declining enfeoffment, he spoke on their behalf, saying:
translations.idiomatic: When Shouren twice memorialized declining enfeoffment, he spoke on their behalf, saying:

sentences.zh: 宸濠變初起，勢焰猖熾，人心疑懼退阻。

translations.literal: When Chenhao's rebellion first erupted, its momentum was fierce and blazing; people's hearts were doubtful, fearful, and held back.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenhao's rebellion first erupted, its momentum was fierce and overwhelming; people's hearts were filled with doubt, fear, and hesitation.

sentences.zh: 當時首從義師，自伍文定、邢珣、徐璉、戴德孺諸人外，又有知府陳槐、曾璵、胡堯元等，知縣劉源清、馬津、傅南喬、李美、李楫及楊材、王冕、顧佖、劉守緒、王軾等，鄉官都御史王懋中，編修鄒守益，御史張鰲山、伍希儒、謝源等。

translations.literal: At that time those who first followed the righteous army, apart from Wu Wending, Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru and others, also included prefects Chen Huai, Zeng Yu, Hu Yaoyuan and others, magistrates Liu Yuanqing, Ma Jin, Fu Nanqiao, Li Mei, Li Ji and Yang Cai, Wang Mian, Gu Bi, Liu Shouxu, Wang Shi and others, local censor-in-chief Wang Maozhong, compiler Zou Shouyi, censors Zhang Aoshan, Wu Xiru, Xie Yuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, those who first joined the righteous army included, besides Wu Wending, Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others, the prefects Chen Huai, Zeng Yu, and Hu Yaoyuan; the magistrates Liu Yuanqing, Ma Jin, Fu Nanqiao, Li Mei, Li Ji, Yang Cai, Wang Mian, Gu Bi, Liu Shouxu, and Wang Shi; the local censor-in-chief Wang Maozhong; the compiler Zou Shouyi; and the censors Zhang Aoshan, Wu Xiru, and Xie Yuan.

sentences.zh: 或摧鋒陷陣，或遮邀伏擊，或贊畫謀議，監錄經紀，所謂同功一體者也。

translations.literal: Some broke the vanguard and charged formations, some intercepted and lay in ambush for surprise attacks, some assisted in planning and deliberation, supervised records and management—what is called shared merit as one body.
translations.idiomatic: Some broke enemy lines and charged formations, some lay in ambush and launched surprise attacks, some assisted in planning and deliberation and supervised records and logistics—the so-called shared merit as one body.

sentences.zh: 帳下之士，若聽選官雷濟，已故義官蕭禹，致仕縣丞龍光，指揮高睿，千戶王佐等，或詐為兵檄以撓其進止，壞其事機，或偽書反間以離其心腹，散其黨與。

translations.literal: Men under his command, such as selected official Lei Ji, the deceased merit appointee Xiao Yu, retired county assistant Long Guang, commander Gao Rui, company commander Wang Zuo and others, either forged military dispatches to disrupt their advance and retreat and ruin their opportunity, or forged letters of counter-intelligence to separate their trusted followers and scatter their faction.
translations.idiomatic: Men under his command—such as the selected official Lei Ji, the deceased merit appointee Xiao Yu, the retired county assistant Long Guang, the commander Gao Rui, and the company commander Wang Zuo—either forged military dispatches to disrupt the enemy's movements and ruin their plans, or forged letters to sow discord among their trusted followers and break up their faction.

sentences.zh: 今聞紀功文冊，改造者多所刪削。

translations.literal: Now I hear that in the merit records and registers, the revisions have cut away much.
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear that in the merit records and registers, the revisions have cut away much of what was recorded.

sentences.zh: 舉人冀元亨為臣勸說甯王，反為奸人構陷，竟死獄中，尤傷心慘目，負之冥冥之中者。

translations.literal: The presented scholar Ji Yuanheng persuaded the Prince of Ning on my behalf, yet was framed by villains and died in prison in the end—especially heartbreaking and gruesome to behold, one who is owed in the deepest dark.
translations.idiomatic: The presented scholar Ji Yuanheng persuaded the Prince of Ning on my behalf, yet was framed by villains and died in prison—a case especially heartbreaking and gruesome to behold, and one for which I bear a debt in the deepest dark.

sentences.zh: 夫宸濠積威淩劫，雖在數千里外，無不震駭失措。

translations.literal: Chenhao's accumulated power and intimidation—even thousands of li away, none failed to be shaken and alarmed into confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao's accumulated power and intimidation were such that even thousands of li away, none failed to be shaken and alarmed into confusion.

sentences.zh: 而況江西諸郡縣切近剝床，觸目皆賊兵，隨處有賊黨，非真有捐軀赴難之義，戮力報主之忠，孰肯甘齏粉之禍，從赤族之誅，蹈必死之地，以希萬一難冀之功乎！

translations.literal: How much more so for the Jiangxi prefectures and counties directly exposed at the foot of the bed—everywhere one looked there were rebel troops, rebel agents at every turn—unless one truly had the righteousness of giving one's body to meet calamity and the loyalty of exerting all strength to repay one's lord, who would willingly accept the disaster of being ground to powder, submit to the execution of the whole clan, tread ground certain to mean death, hoping for merit one in ten thousand times unlikely to be obtained!
translations.idiomatic: How much more so for the Jiangxi prefectures and counties directly exposed to danger—everywhere one looked there were rebel troops, rebel agents at every turn—unless one truly had the righteousness of giving one's body to meet calamity and the loyalty of exerting all strength to repay one's lord, who would willingly accept being ground to powder, submit to the execution of the whole clan, tread ground certain to mean death, and hope for merit one in ten thousand times unlikely to be obtained!

sentences.zh: 今臣獨崇封爵，而此同事諸人者，或賞不行而並削其績，或賞未及而罰已先行，或虛受升職之名而因使退閑，或冒蒙不忠之號而隨以廢斥。

translations.literal: Now I alone am grandly enfeoffed with titles, while these fellow participants—some received no reward and moreover had their merits cut away, some before reward arrived punishment was already imposed, some nominally received promotions yet were thereby made to retire, some falsely bore the label of disloyalty and were then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Now I alone am grandly enfeoffed with titles, while these fellow participants—some received no reward and moreover had their merits cut away; some were punished before any reward arrived; some nominally received promotions yet were thereby made to retire; and some falsely bore the label of disloyalty and were then dismissed.

sentences.zh: 非獨為已斥諸權奸所誣構挫辱而已也。

translations.literal: It is not only that they were already slandered and framed by the various powerful villains and humiliated.
translations.idiomatic: Nor is it only that they were already slandered and framed by the various powerful villains and humiliated.

sentences.zh: 群憎眾嫉，惟事指摘搜羅以為快，曾未見有鳴其不平、伸其屈抑者，臣竊痛之。

translations.literal: Hostility and envy abound; all that matters is picking faults and searching them out for pleasure—I have never seen anyone voice their injustice or redress their wrongs. I am deeply pained.
translations.idiomatic: Hostility and envy abound; all that matters is picking faults and searching them out for pleasure. I have never seen anyone voice their injustice or redress their wrongs, and I am deeply pained.

sentences.zh: 奏入，卒寢不行。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and ultimately shelved without implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and ultimately shelved without being implemented.

sentences.zh: 蔡天祐，字成之，睢州人。

translations.literal: Cai Tianyou, styled Chengzhi, was a man of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Tianyou, styled Chengzhi, was a native of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 父晟，濟南知府，以廉惠聞。

translations.literal: His father Sheng was prefect of Jinan, known for integrity and benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sheng was prefect of Jinan and was known for integrity and benevolence.

sentences.zh: 天祐登弘治十八年進士，改庶起士，授吏科給事中，出為福建僉事。

translations.literal: Tianyou passed the jinshi in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi, was changed to Hanlin probationer, appointed supervising secretary in the Secretariat Personnel Bureau, and went out as administration vice commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou passed the jinshi examination in Hongzhi year 18, was appointed a Hanlin probationer, was made supervising secretary in the Secretariat Personnel Bureau, and went out to serve as administration vice commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 曆山東副使，分巡遼陽。

translations.literal: He served as Shandong vice commissioner, dividing his duties to patrol Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Shandong vice commissioner with responsibility for patrolling Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 歲歉，活饑民萬余。

translations.literal: In a year of famine he kept more than ten thousand starving people alive.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he kept more than ten thousand starving people alive.

sentences.zh: 辟濱海圩田數萬頃，民名之曰「蔡公田」。

translations.literal: He opened tens of thousands of acres of coastal embankment fields, and the people named them "Lord Cai's fields."
translations.idiomatic: He opened tens of thousands of acres of coastal embankment fields, and the people named them "Lord Cai's fields."

sentences.zh: 累遷山西按察使。

translations.literal: He was steadily promoted to Shanxi surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was steadily promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年，大同兵亂，巡撫張文錦遇害。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiajing the Datong troops mutinied and Grand Coordinator Zhang Wenjin was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 3 the Datong troops mutinied and Grand Coordinator Zhang Wenjin was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔曲赦亂卒，改巡撫宣府都御史李鐸撫之。

translations.literal: An edict offered a partial pardon to the mutinous soldiers and changed Grand Coordinator of Xuanfu Li Duo to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered a partial pardon to the mutinous soldiers and transferred Grand Coordinator of Xuanfu Li Duo to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 鐸以母憂不至，乃擢天祐右僉都御史，巡撫大同。

translations.literal: Duo did not come on account of mourning for his mother; Tianyou was then promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Duo did not come on account of mourning for his mother, so Tianyou was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Datong.

sentences.zh: 天祐從數騎馳入城，諭軍士獻首惡，眾心稍定。

translations.literal: Tianyou rushed into the city with only a few horsemen, exhorted the soldiers to surrender the ringleaders, and the crowd's mood gradually settled.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou rushed into the city with only a few horsemen, exhorted the soldiers to surrender the ringleaders, and the troops gradually calmed.

sentences.zh: 會尚書金獻民、總兵官杭雄出師甘肅，道大同，亂卒疑見討，復鼓噪。

translations.literal: When Minister Jin Xianmin and Regional Commander Hang Xiong marched toward Gansu and passed through Datong, the mutinous soldiers suspected they had come to attack and again raised a clamor.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister Jin Xianmin and Regional Commander Hang Xiong marched toward Gansu and passed through Datong, the mutinous soldiers suspected they had come to attack and again raised a clamor.

sentences.zh: 天祐懼，急請再赦。

translations.literal: Tianyou grew afraid and urgently requested another pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou grew afraid and urgently requested another pardon.

sentences.zh: 兵部言「元惡不除無以警後」。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said, "Unless the chief villains are removed there is no way to warn those who come after."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War said, "Unless the chief villains are removed there is no way to warn those who come after."

sentences.zh: 請特遣大臣總督宣、大軍務，以制其變。

translations.literal: They requested that a special senior minister be dispatched to take overall command of military affairs in Xuan and Datong to control the situation.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that a special senior minister be dispatched to take overall command of military affairs in Xuanfu and Datong to control the situation.

sentences.zh: 乃命戶部侍郎胡瓚偕都督魯綱統京軍三千人以往。

translations.literal: Hu Zan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was then ordered to go together with Commander Lu Gang, leading three thousand capital troops.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was then ordered to go together with Commander Lu Gang at the head of three thousand capital troops.

sentences.zh: 瓚等未發而進士李枝齎餉銀至。

translations.literal: Before Zan and the others set out, jinshi Li Zhi arrived carrying supply silver.
translations.idiomatic: Before Zan and the others set out, the jinshi Li Zhi arrived carrying supply silver.

sentences.zh: 亂卒曰：「此承密詔盡殺大同人，為軍犒也。

translations.literal: The mutinous soldiers said, "This implements a secret edict to kill all the people of Datong—it is army bounty.
translations.idiomatic: The mutinous soldiers said, "This carries out a secret edict to kill all the people of Datong—it is bounty for the army.

sentences.zh: 」夜中火起，圍枝館，出牒示之乃解。

translations.literal: That night fire broke out; they surrounded Li Zhi's lodge, and only when documents were produced and shown to them did they disperse.
translations.idiomatic: That night fire broke out; they surrounded Li Zhi's lodge, and only when documents were produced and shown to them did they disperse.

sentences.zh: 尋復殺知縣王文昌，圍代王府，脅王奏乞赦。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they again killed Magistrate Wang Wenchang, surrounded the Prince of Dai's residence, and coerced the prince to memorialize begging pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they again killed Magistrate Wang Wenchang, surrounded the Prince of Dai's residence, and coerced the prince to memorialize begging pardon.

sentences.zh: 王急攜二郡王走宣府。

translations.literal: The prince urgently fled with two commandery princes to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The prince urgently fled with two commandery princes to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史王官言：「亂卒方囂，大兵壓境，是趣之叛也。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Wang Guan said, "The mutinous soldiers are just now clamorous, and great armies press the border—this will only drive them to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Wang Guan said, "The mutinous soldiers are just now clamorous, and great armies press the border—this will only drive them to rebel.

sentences.zh: 請亟止禁軍，容臣密圖。

translations.literal: I beg that the capital troops be halted immediately, and that I be allowed to plan in secret."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the capital troops be halted immediately and that I be allowed to plan in secret."

sentences.zh: 」乃命瓚駐兵宣府。

translations.literal: Zan was then ordered to halt his troops at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was then ordered to halt his troops at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 頃之，天祐奏總兵官桂勇已捕五十四人，請止京軍勿遣。

translations.literal: Before long Tianyou memorialized that Regional Commander Gui Yong had already captured fifty-four men and requested that the capital troops not be sent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tianyou memorialized that Regional Commander Gui Yong had already captured fifty-four men and requested that the capital troops not be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 帝責以阻撓，令必獲首惡郭鑒等。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked him for obstruction and ordered that the ringleaders Guo Jian and others must be captured.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for obstruction and ordered that the ringleaders Guo Jian and others must be captured.

sentences.zh: 既而瓚次陽和，勇、天祐令千戶苗登擒斬鑒等十一人，函首送瓚，請班師。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zan reached Yanghe; Yong and Tianyou had Company Commander Miao Deng capture and behead Jian and eleven others, sent the heads in boxes to Zan, and requested withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zan reached Yanghe; Yong and Tianyou had Company Commander Miao Deng capture and behead Jian and eleven others, sent the heads in boxes to Zan, and requested withdrawal of the army.

sentences.zh: 甫二日，鑒父郭疤子復糾徐氈兒等夜殺勇家人，又毀苗登家。

translations.literal: Barely two days later, Jian's father Guo Bazizi again gathered Xu Zhan'er and others to kill Yong's family at night, and also destroyed Miao Deng's house.
translations.idiomatic: Barely two days later, Jian's father Guo Bazizi again gathered Xu Zhan'er and others to kill Yong's family at night and also destroyed Miao Deng's house.

sentences.zh: 瓚言非盡殲不可。

translations.literal: Zan said they could not be dealt with unless completely annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: Zan said the mutineers could not be pacified unless they were completely annihilated.

sentences.zh: 帝乃切讓天祐，召勇還京，以故總兵硃振代之，敕瓚仍駐宣府。

translations.literal: The emperor then sharply rebuked Tianyou, recalled Yong to the capital, replaced him with the former regional commander Zhu Zhen, and ordered Zan to remain stationed at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then sharply rebuked Tianyou, recalled Yong to the capital, replaced him with the former regional commander Zhu Zhen, and ordered Zan to remain stationed at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 居無何，天祐捕戮徐氈兒等，瓚等遂班師。

translations.literal: Before long Tianyou captured and executed Xu Zhan'er and others; Zan and the others then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tianyou captured and executed Xu Zhan'er and others, and Zan and the others then withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，侍郎李昆、孟春，總兵官馬永交章言疤子潛逃塞外，必為後患。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, Vice Ministers Li Kun and Meng Chun and Regional Commander Ma Yong jointly memorialized that Bazizi had secretly fled beyond the frontier and would surely become a future threat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, Vice Ministers Li Kun and Meng Chun and Regional Commander Ma Yong jointly memorialized that Bazizi had secretly fled beyond the frontier and would surely become a future threat.

sentences.zh: 帝將遣使勘，會瓚還京言逃卒無足患，帝乃罷勘官勿遣。

translations.literal: The emperor was about to dispatch an inspector when Zan returned to the capital and said the escaped soldiers were no great concern; the emperor then canceled sending the inspector.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was about to dispatch an inspector when Zan returned to the capital and said the escaped soldiers were no great concern; the emperor then canceled sending the inspector.

sentences.zh: 疤子復潛入城，焚振第。

translations.literal: Bazizi again secretly entered the city and burned Zhen's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Bazizi again secretly entered the city and burned Zhen's residence.

sentences.zh: 明旦，天祐閉城大索。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day Tianyou closed the city and searched extensively.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day Tianyou closed the city and conducted a thorough search.

sentences.zh: 獲疤子及其黨三十四人，悉斬以徇。

translations.literal: They captured Bazizi and thirty-four of his followers and executed them all as a public warning.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Bazizi and thirty-four of his followers and executed them all as a public warning.

sentences.zh: 盡宥脅從，人心乃大定。

translations.literal: All who had been coerced were pardoned, and public sentiment was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: All who had been coerced were pardoned, and public sentiment was greatly settled.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, silver and silks were bestowed as reward.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, silver and silks were bestowed as reward.

sentences.zh: 已，進副都御史，巡撫如故。

translations.literal: Thereafter he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief while continuing as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief while continuing as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 尋就進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was further promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was further promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 久之，召還部。

translations.literal: After a long time he was recalled to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was recalled to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 天祐以籓祿久缺，又歲當繕邊垣，用便宜增淮鹽引價，每引萬加銀五千，被訐。

translations.literal: Tianyou, because fief stipends had long been in arrears and it was also the year for repairing the frontier walls, used his discretionary authority to raise the price of Huai salt certificates, adding five thousand taels of silver per ten thousand certificates, and was impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou, because fief stipends had long been in arrears and it was also the year for repairing the frontier walls, used his discretionary authority to raise the price of Huai salt certificates, adding five thousand taels of silver per certificate, and was impeached.

sentences.zh: 帝宥之。

translations.literal: The emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 至是，御史李宗樞復追論前事，天祐因引疾去。

translations.literal: At this time Censor Li Zongshu again pursued investigation of the earlier affair; Tianyou therefore cited illness and resigned.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Censor Li Zongshu again pursued investigation of the earlier affair, and Tianyou therefore cited illness and resigned.

sentences.zh: 居二年，奉詔起用。

translations.literal: After two years he was ordered by edict to return to service.
translations.idiomatic: After two years he was ordered by edict to return to service.

sentences.zh: 未至京，得疾告歸，卒。

translations.literal: Before reaching the capital he fell ill, requested leave to return home, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching the capital he fell ill, requested leave to return home, and died.

sentences.zh: 年九十五。

translations.literal: He was ninety-five years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was ninety-five years old.

sentences.zh: 天祐有才智。

translations.literal: Tianyou had talent and wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou had talent and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 兵變時。

translations.literal: At the time of the military mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of the military mutiny.

sentences.zh: 左右皆賊耳目，幕府動靜悉知之。

translations.literal: Those on his left and right were all the rebels' eyes and ears; every movement of the headquarters was fully known to them.
translations.idiomatic: Those around him were all the rebels' eyes and ears; every movement of the headquarters was fully known to them.

sentences.zh: 天祐廣招星卜藝士往來軍中，因具得其情，卒賴以成功。

translations.literal: Tianyou widely recruited astrologers and men of various arts to come and go in the army, and thereby fully learned their situation; success in the end relied on this.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou widely recruited astrologers and men of various arts to come and go in the army, and thereby fully learned their situation; success in the end relied on this.

sentences.zh: 在鎮七年，威德大著，父老為立安輯祠。

translations.literal: During seven years in the post his prestige and virtue were greatly noted; the elders established an Anji Temple for him.
translations.idiomatic: During seven years in the post his prestige and virtue were greatly noted, and the elders established an Anji Temple for him.

sentences.zh: 胡瓚，字伯珩，永平人。

translations.literal: Hu Zan, styled Boheng, was a man of Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan, styled Boheng, was a native of Yongping.

sentences.zh: 進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He was a jinshi.

sentences.zh: 官終南京工部尚書。

translations.literal: He ended his career as Minister of Works in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as Minister of Works in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 張文錦，安丘人。

translations.literal: Zhang Wenjin, a man of Anqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenjin was a native of Anqiu.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年進士，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi in the twelfth year of Hongzhi and was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Hongzhi year 12 and was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正德初，為劉瑾所陷，逮系詔獄，斥為民。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengde he was framed by Liu Jin, arrested and imprisoned in the imperial prison, and dismissed as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he was framed by Liu Jin, arrested and imprisoned in the imperial prison, and dismissed as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 瑾誅，起故官。

translations.literal: After Jin was executed he was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: After Jin was executed he was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 再遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted again to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 督稅陝西，條上籌邊裕民十事。

translations.literal: Supervising tax collection in Shaanxi, he submitted ten measures for securing the frontier and enriching the people.
translations.idiomatic: While supervising tax collection in Shaanxi, he submitted ten measures for securing the frontier and enriching the people.

sentences.zh: 遷安慶知府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Anqing.

sentences.zh: 度甯王宸濠必反，與都指揮楊銳為禦備計。

translations.literal: He judged that Prince of Ning Chenhao would surely rebel and with Regional Commander Yang Rui made plans for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He judged that Prince of Ning Chenhao would surely rebel and with Regional Commander Yang Rui made plans for defense.

sentences.zh: 宸濠果反，浮江下。

translations.literal: Chenhao did rebel and sailed down the river.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao did rebel and sailed down the river.

sentences.zh: 文錦等慮其攻南都，令軍士登城詬之。

translations.literal: Wenjin and the others feared he would attack the Southern Capital and had soldiers mount the walls to revile him.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin and the others feared he would attack the Southern Capital and had soldiers mount the walls to revile him.

sentences.zh: 宸濠乃留攻，卒不能克。

translations.literal: Chenhao therefore stayed to attack but ultimately could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Chenhao therefore stayed to attack but ultimately could not take it.

sentences.zh: 事具《楊銳傳》。

translations.literal: The affair is fully related in the Biography of Yang Rui.
