translations.idiomatic: The affair is fully related in the Biography of Yang Rui.

sentences.zh: 璽書褒美，擢太僕少卿。

translations.literal: An imperial edict of commendation praised him and he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict of commendation praised him, and he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，拜右副都御史，巡撫大同。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 1 he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Datong.

sentences.zh: 文錦性剛。

translations.literal: Wenjin was by nature stern.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin was by nature stern.

sentences.zh: 以拒賊得重名，遂銳意振刷，操切頗無序。

translations.literal: Because resisting the rebels had won him a heavy reputation, he thereupon set his mind on vigorous reform; his handling was sharp and rather disordered.
translations.idiomatic: Because resisting the rebels had won him a heavy reputation, he thereupon set his mind on vigorous reform; his handling was sharp and rather disordered.

sentences.zh: 大同北四望平衍，寇至無可禦。

translations.literal: North of Datong all views on four sides were level and open; when raiders came there was nothing to block them.
translations.idiomatic: North of Datong the land was level and open on every side; when raiders came there was nothing to block them.

sentences.zh: 文錦曰：「寇犯宣府不能近鎮城者，以葛谷、白陽諸堡為外蔽也。

translations.literal: Wenjin said, "When raiders invade Xuanfu they cannot approach the garrison city because Ge Valley, Baiyang and other forts serve as outer screens.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin said, "When raiders invade Xuanfu they cannot approach the garrison city because Ge Valley, Baiyang, and other forts serve as outer screens.

sentences.zh: 今城外即戰場，何以示重？

translations.literal: Now the battlefield is right outside the city walls—how can this show weight?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the battlefield is right outside the city walls—how can this show weight?"

sentences.zh: 」議於城北九十里外，增設五堡，曰水口、宣寧、只河、柳溝、樺溝。

translations.literal: It was decided to add five forts ninety li north of the city: Shuikou, Xuannning, Zhihe, Liugou, and Huagou.
translations.idiomatic: It was decided to add five forts ninety li north of the city: Shuikou, Xuannning, Zhihe, Liugou, and Huagou.

sentences.zh: 參將賈鑒督役嚴，卒已怨。

translations.literal: Assistant Regional Commander Jia Jian supervised the labor strictly; the soldiers were already resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Regional Commander Jia Jian supervised the labor strictly, and the soldiers were already resentful.

sentences.zh: 及堡成，欲徙鎮卒二千五百家戍之。

translations.literal: When the forts were completed, he wished to transfer twenty-five hundred garrison households to guard them.
translations.idiomatic: When the forts were completed, he wished to transfer twenty-five hundred garrison households to guard them.

sentences.zh: 眾憚行，請募新丁，僚吏鹹以為言。

translations.literal: The crowd feared going; they requested recruiting new recruits; the subordinate officials all spoke in favor of this.
translations.idiomatic: The troops feared going and requested recruiting new recruits instead; the subordinate officials all spoke in favor of this.

sentences.zh: 文錦怒曰：「如此，則令不行矣。

translations.literal: Wenjin angrily said, "If it is like this, then orders will not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin angrily said, "If it is like this, then orders will not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 鎮親兵先往，孰敢後！

translations.literal: The garrison's personal troops go first—who would dare lag behind!"
translations.idiomatic: The garrison's personal troops go first—who would dare lag behind!"

sentences.zh: 」親兵素遊惰有室。

translations.literal: The personal troops had long been idle pleasure-seekers with families.
translations.idiomatic: The personal troops had long been idle pleasure-seekers with families.

sentences.zh: 聞當發，大恐。

translations.literal: Hearing they were to be dispatched, they were greatly terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing they were to be dispatched, they were greatly terrified.

sentences.zh: 請孑身往，得分番。

translations.literal: They requested going alone without families, in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: They requested going alone without their families, in rotation.

sentences.zh: 又不聽，嚴趣之。

translations.literal: This too was not granted; strict orders hurried them on.
translations.idiomatic: This too was not granted, and strict orders hurried them on.

sentences.zh: 鑒承風，杖其隊長。

translations.literal: Jian, following the wind, caned their squad leader.
translations.idiomatic: Jian, taking his cue from above, caned their squad leader.

sentences.zh: 諸邊卒自甘州五衛殺巡撫許銘，朝廷處之輕，頗無忌。

translations.literal: The frontier soldiers, since the five guards of Ganzhou had killed Grand Coordinator Xu Ming and the court had treated the matter lightly, had little fear.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier soldiers, since the five guards of Ganzhou had killed Grand Coordinator Xu Ming and the court had treated the matter lightly, had little fear.

sentences.zh: 至是，卒郭鑒、柳忠等乘眾憤，遂倡亂。

translations.literal: At this time soldiers Guo Jian, Liu Zhong and others, taking advantage of the crowd's anger, then incited the mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: At this time soldiers Guo Jian, Liu Zhong, and others, taking advantage of the crowd's anger, then incited the mutiny.

sentences.zh: 殺賈鑒，裂其屍，走出塞，屯焦山墩。

translations.literal: They killed Jia Jian, tore his corpse apart, fled beyond the frontier, and encamped at Jiaoshan Beacon.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Jia Jian, tore his corpse apart, fled beyond the frontier, and encamped at Jiaoshan Beacon.

sentences.zh: 文錦恐與外寇連，令副將時陳等招之入城，即索治首亂者。

translations.literal: Wenjin feared they would join with external raiders and ordered Vice General Shi Chen and others to summon them back into the city, then immediately demanded the punishment of the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin feared they would join with external raiders and ordered Vice General Shi Chen and others to summon them back into the city, then immediately demanded the punishment of the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 郭鑒等大懼，復聚為亂，焚大同府門，入行都司縱獄囚，又焚都御史府門。

translations.literal: Guo Jian and others were greatly terrified, gathered again to rebel, burned the gate of Datong Prefecture, entered the Regional Military Commission to release prisoners, and again burned the gate of the Censor-in-Chief's office.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jian and the others, seized with terror, rose again in mutiny. They burned the gate of Datong Prefecture, entered the Regional Military Commission to free the prisoners, and burned the gate of the grand coordinator's yamen as well.

sentences.zh: 文錦逾垣走，匿博野王府第。

translations.literal: Wenjin climbed over the wall and fled, hiding in the residence of the Prince of Boye.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin scaled the wall and fled, taking refuge in the mansion of the Prince of Boye.

sentences.zh: 亂卒欲燔王宮。

translations.literal: The mutinous soldiers wished to burn the princely palace.
translations.idiomatic: The mutinous soldiers wanted to burn the princely residence.

sentences.zh: 王懼，出文錦。

translations.literal: The prince feared, and produced Wenjin.
translations.idiomatic: The prince, in fear, handed Wenjin over.

sentences.zh: 郭鑒等殺之，亦裂其屍，遂焚鎮守總兵公署。

translations.literal: Guo Jian and others killed him, also tore his corpse apart, and then burned the headquarters of the regional commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jian and his followers killed him, tore his corpse apart, and then burned the headquarters of the regional commander.

sentences.zh: 出故總兵硃振于獄，脅為帥。

translations.literal: They released the former regional commander Zhu Zhen from prison and coerced him to be commander.
translations.idiomatic: They freed the former regional commander Zhu Zhen from prison and forced him to serve as their leader.

sentences.zh: 時嘉靖三年八月也。

translations.literal: It was the eighth month of the third year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: This occurred in the eighth month of Jiajing year 3.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝命侍郎李昆赦亂卒。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor ordered Vice Minister Li Kun to pardon the mutinous soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor ordered Vice Minister Li Kun to grant amnesty to the mutinous soldiers.

sentences.zh: 昆為文錦請恤典，不報，久之，文錦父政訟其子守安慶功，禮部為之請，終不許。

translations.literal: Kun requested posthumous honors for Wenjin; no reply was given. After a long time, Wenjin's father Zheng sued over his son's merit in defending Anqing; the Ministry of Rites requested on his behalf, but in the end it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Kun petitioned for posthumous honors for Wenjin, but received no response. Long afterward, Wenjin's father Zheng brought suit over his son's merits in defending Anqing; the Ministry of Rites interceded on his behalf, but the throne still refused.

sentences.zh: 文錦妻李氏復上疏哀請。

translations.literal: Wenjin's wife Lady Li again submitted a memorial pleading in grief.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin's wife, Lady Li, submitted another memorial pleading in anguish.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，命執齎疏者治之。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and ordered that the person who delivered the memorial be seized and punished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor flew into a rage and ordered the bearer of the memorial arrested and punished.

sentences.zh: 副都御史陳洪謨言：「文錦僨事，朝廷戮之可也。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Chen Hongmo said: "Wenjin brought ruin through rash action; the court might have executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Chen Hongmo said, "Wenjin brought ruin upon himself through reckless conduct; the court could have put him to death.

sentences.zh: 假手士卒，傳之四方，損國威不小。

translations.literal: To use soldiers' hands and spread it to the four quarters damages national prestige no little.
translations.idiomatic: But to leave the killing to mutinous soldiers and let the story spread across the realm has done no small harm to the dynasty's prestige.

sentences.zh: 」復降旨詰責。

translations.literal: " An edict was again issued reproaching her.
translations.idiomatic: " Another imperial edict was issued reproaching Lady Li.

sentences.zh: 自是，廷臣不敢言。

translations.literal: From this time, court officials did not dare speak.
translations.idiomatic: After that, no one at court dared raise the matter again.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，始贈右都御史。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, he was at last granted the posthumous rank of Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Only during the Wanli reign was he posthumously granted the rank of Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，追諡忠湣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi, he was posthumously given the title Loyal and Compassionate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianqi reign, he was posthumously honored with the title Zhongmin, "Loyal and Compassionate."

sentences.zh: 詹榮，字仁甫，山海衛人。

translations.literal: Zhan Rong, styled Renfu, was a man of Shanhai Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhan Rong, styled Renfu, was a native of Shanhai Guard.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖五年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Jiajing year 5.

sentences.zh: 授戶部主事，曆郎中。

translations.literal: Appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue; served through the rank of department director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and rose to department director.

sentences.zh: 督餉大同，值兵變，殺總兵官李瑾。

translations.literal: Supervising grain supplies at Datong, he encountered a military mutiny that killed Regional Commander Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: While supervising grain supplies at Datong, he was caught up in a mutiny in which the soldiers killed Regional Commander Li Jin.

sentences.zh: 總督劉源清率師圍城，久不下。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Liu Yuanqing led troops to besiege the city; for a long time they could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Liu Yuanqing led an army to besiege the city, but could not reduce it for a long time.

sentences.zh: 榮素有智略，善應變。

translations.literal: Rong had long possessed wisdom and stratagem, and was skilled at responding to change.
translations.idiomatic: Rong had always been quick-witted and resourceful, skilled at adapting to crisis.

sentences.zh: 叛卒掠城中，無犯榮者。

translations.literal: The rebel soldiers plundered within the city, but none violated Rong.
translations.idiomatic: Though the mutineers plundered the city, none laid a hand on Rong.

sentences.zh: 週邊益急，榮密約都指揮紀振、遊擊戴濂、鎮撫王寧同盟討賊。

translations.literal: As the siege grew more pressing, Rong secretly arranged with Regional Commander Ji Zhen, Mobile Commander Dai Lian, and Garrison Commander Wang Ning to join in alliance to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: As the siege tightened, Rong secretly pledged an alliance with Regional Commander Ji Zhen, Mobile Commander Dai Lian, and Garrison Commander Wang Ning to put down the rebels together.

sentences.zh: 察叛卒馬升、楊麟無逆志，乃陽令寧持官民狀詣源清所，為叛卒乞原，而陰以榮謀告，請宥升、麟死，畀三千金，俾募死士自效。

translations.literal: Observing that rebel soldiers Ma Sheng and Yang Lin had no rebellious intent, he then openly ordered Ning to take the petition of officials and people to Yuanqing's camp, begging pardon for the rebels, while secretly informing Yuanqing of Rong's plan, requesting pardon for Sheng and Lin from death, granting three thousand taels of gold, and enabling them to recruit desperate men to serve in redemption.
translations.idiomatic: Finding that the rebel soldiers Ma Sheng and Yang Lin bore no treasonous intent, he openly sent Wang Ning with a petition from officials and townspeople to Yuanqing's camp seeking amnesty for the mutineers, while secretly apprising Yuanqing of his plan: spare Ma and Yang from execution, grant them three thousand taels of silver, and let them raise a corps of die-hard fighters to prove their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 會源清已罷，巡撫樊繼祖許之。

translations.literal: It happened that Yuanqing had already been dismissed; Grand Coordinator Fan Jizu granted it.
translations.idiomatic: By then Yuanqing had already been removed from office, and Grand Coordinator Fan Jizu approved the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 升、麟遂結心腹，擒首惡黃鎮等九人戮之。

translations.literal: Sheng and Lin then rallied trusted followers, captured the ringleaders Huang Zhen and nine others, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Ma and Yang rallied their trusted followers, seized the ringleaders Huang Zhen and eight others, and put them to death.

sentences.zh: 榮乃開城門，延繼祖入，復捕斬二十六人。

translations.literal: Rong then opened the city gate, invited Jizu to enter, and again captured and beheaded twenty-six men.
translations.idiomatic: Rong then opened the city gates, admitted Fan Jizu, and twenty-six more men were arrested and executed.

sentences.zh: 錄功，擢光祿寺少卿，再遷太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: Recording merit, he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and again transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: His service was officially recognized: he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, then transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以右僉都御史巡撫甘肅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he became grand coordinator of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 22, he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 魯迷貢使留甘州者九十余人，總兵官楊信驅以禦寇，死者十之一。

translations.literal: More than ninety tribute envoys from Rum who remained at Ganzhou were driven by Regional Commander Yang Xin to resist raiders; one in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: More than ninety tribute envoys from Rum who were staying at Ganzhou were driven by Regional Commander Yang Xin into battle against raiders; one in ten died.

sentences.zh: 榮言：「彼以好來，而用之鋒鏑，失遠人心，且示中國弱。

translations.literal: Rong said: "They came in friendship, yet we used them at spear and sword-point; this loses the hearts of distant peoples and moreover shows China weak.
translations.idiomatic: Rong memorialized: "They came in friendship, yet we sent them into the clash of arms. This alienates distant peoples and advertises the empire's weakness.

sentences.zh: 」詔奪信官，槥死者送之歸。

translations.literal: " An edict stripped Xin of office; the dead were coffined and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered Yang Xin's dismissal, had the dead placed in coffins, and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 番人感悅。

translations.literal: The frontier peoples were moved and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier peoples were deeply gratified.

sentences.zh: 逾年，以大同巡撫趙錦與總兵官周尚文不相能，詔榮與錦易任。

translations.literal: After a year, because Datong Grand Coordinator Zhao Jin and Regional Commander Zhou Shangwen could not get along, an edict exchanged posts between Rong and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, because Grand Coordinator Zhao Jin of Datong and Regional Commander Zhou Shangwen could not work together, the throne ordered Rong and Zhao to swap posts.

sentences.zh: 俺答數萬騎入掠，榮與尚文破之黑山陽，進右副都御史。

translations.literal: Altan with tens of thousands of riders entered to raid; Rong and Shangwen defeated them at the sunny slope of Heishan, and Rong was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan led tens of thousands of horsemen in a raid, Rong and Zhou Shangwen routed them on the sunny slope of Black Mountain, and Rong was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 寇復大舉犯中路，參將張鳳等陣歿。

translations.literal: The raiders again came in great force attacking the middle route; Regional Vice Commander Zhang Feng and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders returned in force against the middle sector; Regional Vice Commander Zhang Feng and others fell on the field.

sentences.zh: 榮與尚文及總督翁萬達嚴兵備陽和，而遣騎邀擊，多所殺傷，寇乃引去。

translations.literal: Rong, Shangwen, and Grand Coordinator Weng Wanda strictly prepared troops at Yanghe, sent cavalry to intercept and attack, killed and wounded many, and the raiders then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Rong, Zhou Shangwen, and Grand Coordinator Weng Wanda massed their forces at Yanghe, sent cavalry to harry the enemy along the route, inflicted heavy casualties, and the raiders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 代府奉國將軍充灼行剽，榮奏奪其祿。

translations.literal: Chong Zhuo, Prince of the State of the Dais' Fengguo General, practiced plunder; Rong memorialized to strip his stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Chong Zhuo, a State Supporting General of the Princedom of Dai, had taken to raiding; Rong memorialized for the confiscation of his stipend.

sentences.zh: 充灼等結小王子入寇，謀據大同。

translations.literal: Chong Zhuo and others linked with the Little Prince to enter and raid, plotting to seize Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Chong Zhuo and his confederates colluded with the Little Prince to raid the frontier and plotted to seize Datong.

sentences.zh: 榮告尚文捕得，皆伏辜。

translations.literal: Rong informed Shangwen, who captured them; all paid for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Rong alerted Zhou Shangwen, who captured them; all were duly punished.

sentences.zh: 榮以大同無險，乃築東路邊牆百三十八里，堡七，墩台百五十四。

translations.literal: Rong, because Datong had no natural defenses, then built the eastern-route border wall one hundred thirty-eight li, seven forts, and one hundred fifty-four beacon towers.
translations.idiomatic: Concluding that Datong lacked natural defenses, Rong built one hundred thirty-eight li of border wall along the eastern route, seven forts, and one hundred fifty-four beacon towers.

sentences.zh: 又以守邊當積粟。

translations.literal: He also held that defending the frontier should entail storing grain.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that frontier defense required stored grain.

sentences.zh: 而近邊弘賜諸堡三十一所，延亙五百餘里，辟治之皆膏腴田，可數十萬頃。

translations.literal: And the thirty-one forts of Hongsi and others near the border, extending more than five hundred li—once cleared and cultivated, all were fertile fields, amounting to several hundred thousand qing.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-one nearby forts of the Hongsi sector stretched more than five hundred li; once cleared and cultivated, they yielded fertile fields totaling several hundred thousand qing.

sentences.zh: 乃奏請召軍佃作，復其租徭，移大同一歲市馬費市牛賦之；

translations.literal: He then memorialized requesting to summon soldiers to farm, restore their rents and corvée, and divert Datong's annual horse-market funds to purchase oxen and assign them.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to have troops called out to farm the land, exempt them from rents and corvée labor, and repurpose Datong's annual horse-purchase budget to buy oxen for distribution.

sentences.zh: 秋冬則聚而遏寇。

translations.literal: In autumn and winter they would gather to check raiders.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn and winter the troops would muster there to block raiders.

sentences.zh: 帝立從焉。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately assented.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor promptly approved.

sentences.zh: 寇入犯，與尚文破之彌陀山，斬一部長。

translations.literal: When raiders entered to attack, together with Shangwen he defeated them at Mount Mituo and beheaded one clan chief.
translations.idiomatic: When raiders struck again, he and Zhou Shangwen defeated them at Mount Mituo and beheaded a tribal chief.

sentences.zh: 榮先以靖亂功，進兵部右侍郎，又以繕邊破敵，累被獎賚。

translations.literal: Rong, first for merit in pacifying the mutiny, was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War; then for repairing the frontier and defeating the enemy, he was repeatedly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: For quelling the mutiny he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War; for fortifying the frontier and defeating the enemy he received repeated rewards from the throne.

sentences.zh: 召還理部事，進左。

translations.literal: Summoned back to manage ministry affairs; promoted to Left.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to manage affairs at the Ministry of War and promoted to Left Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 尚書趙廷瑞罷，榮署部務，奏行秋防十事。

translations.literal: When Minister Zhao Tingrui was dismissed, Rong took charge of ministry affairs and memorialized ten measures for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Minister Zhao Tingrui was removed, Rong acted in his stead and submitted ten measures for autumn frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 已而翁萬達入為尚書，遭母喪，榮復當署部務，辭疾乞休。

translations.literal: Soon Weng Wanda entered service as minister; upon his mother's death, Rong again was to take charge of ministry affairs, but pleaded illness and requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Weng Wanda entered the ministry as minister but was mourning his mother; Rong was again expected to act in his place, yet he pleaded illness and asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，奪職閑住。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and stripped him of office, leaving him idle at home.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, angered, stripped him of rank and sent him home in disgrace.

sentences.zh: 越二年卒。

translations.literal: After two years he died.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he died.

sentences.zh: 當榮之撫大同也，萬達為總督，尚文為總兵。

translations.literal: When Rong governed Datong, Wanda was grand coordinator and Shangwen was regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: While Rong served as grand coordinator of Datong, Weng Wanda was frontier governor-general and Zhou Shangwen was regional commander.

sentences.zh: 三人皆有才略，寇數入不能得志。

translations.literal: All three had talent and stratagem; though raiders entered several times, they could not have their way.
translations.idiomatic: All three were men of talent and skill; though raiders struck repeatedly, they never gained their object.

sentences.zh: 自後代者不能任，寇無歲不入躪邊，人益思榮等。

translations.literal: Afterward their successors could not bear the burden; raiders entered every year to trample the border, and people increasingly missed Rong and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Their successors proved unequal to the task; raiders crossed the border every year, and men looked back all the more fondly on Rong and his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 明年，俺答薄京師，萬達、榮皆已去。

translations.literal: The next year Altan pressed close to the capital; Wanda and Rong had both already departed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Altan raided to the very walls of the capital; by then both Weng Wanda and Rong were gone.

sentences.zh: 論者謂二人在，寇未必至此。

translations.literal: Discussants said had the two men remained, the raiders would not necessarily have reached this.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that had the two men still been in office, the raiders might never have come so far.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，榮孫延為順天通判，上書訟榮功。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, Rong's grandson Yan served as deputy magistrate of Shuntian and submitted a memorial pleading Rong's merits.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign, Rong's grandson Yan, serving as deputy magistrate of Shuntian, submitted a memorial vindicating his grandfather's record.

sentences.zh: 贈工部尚書，予恤如制。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Minister of Works; mourning compensation was given according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Rong was posthumously granted the rank of Minister of Works, with mourning benefits according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 劉源清，字汝澄，東平人。

translations.literal: Liu Yuanqing, styled Rucheng, was a man of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yuanqing, styled Rucheng, was a native of Dongping.

sentences.zh: 正德九年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the ninth year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengde year 9.

sentences.zh: 授進賢知縣。

translations.literal: Appointed magistrate of Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，源清積薪環室，命家人曰：「事急，火吾家。

translations.literal: When Prince Ning rebelled, Yuanqing piled firewood around his dwelling and ordered his family: "If matters grow urgent, burn my house.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Ning rebelled, Yuanqing piled firewood around his house and told his family, "If matters turn desperate, burn this house down.

sentences.zh: 」一僕逸，手刃以徇。

translations.literal: " One servant fled; he killed him with his own hand as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: " One servant tried to flee; Yuanqing cut him down with his own hand as an example to the rest.

sentences.zh: 縣中諸惡少與賊通者，悉杖殺之。

translations.literal: All the young ruffians in the county who communicated with the rebels he beat to death with rods.
translations.idiomatic: Every local ruffian who had dealings with the rebels he had beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 宸濠妃弟婁伯歸上饒募兵，源清邀戮之。

translations.literal: Prince Ning's consort's younger brother Lou Bo returned to Shangrao to raise troops; Yuanqing waylaid and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Bo, younger brother of the Prince of Ning's consort, returned to Shangrao to raise troops; Yuanqing ambushed and killed him.

sentences.zh: 賊檄至，立斬其使。

translations.literal: When the rebel proclamation arrived, he immediately beheaded the messenger.
translations.idiomatic: When a rebel manifesto arrived, he immediately beheaded the bearer.

sentences.zh: 會余幹知縣馬津、龍津驛丞孫天祐亦起兵拒賊。

translations.literal: It happened that Yegan Magistrate Ma Jin and Longjin Post Station assistant Sun Tianyou also raised troops to resist the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yegan Magistrate Ma Jin and Longjin Post assistant Sun Tianyou also took up arms against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊七殿下者，奪運舟于龍津，天祐與戰，殺數人。

translations.literal: The rebel "Seventh Highness" seized transport boats at Longjin; Tianyou fought him and killed several men.
translations.idiomatic: A rebel known as the Seventh Highness seized transport boats at Longjin; Sun Tianyou fought him and killed several of his men.

sentences.zh: 賊党募兵過龍津，天祐追殺之，焚其舟。

translations.literal: Rebel partisans raising troops passed Longjin; Tianyou pursued and killed them, burning their boats.
translations.idiomatic: When rebel recruits passed through Longjin, Sun Tianyou pursued them, killed many, and burned their boats.

sentences.zh: 婁氏家眾西下，亦為天祐所遏，擒七十餘人。

translations.literal: The Lou clan's household followers moved westward and were also blocked by Tianyou, who captured more than seventy men.
translations.idiomatic: The Lou family's armed followers marching west were likewise blocked by Sun Tianyou, who captured more than seventy men.

sentences.zh: 賊兵不敢經湖東以窺兩浙者，三人力也。

translations.literal: That rebel troops dared not pass east of the lake to spy on the two Zhe provinces was due to the three men's strength.
translations.idiomatic: That rebel forces dared not cross east of Lake Poyang to threaten the two Zhe provinces was owed to these three men.

sentences.zh: 賊平，源清征為御史。

translations.literal: When the rebellion was pacified, Yuanqing was summoned as censor.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebellion was suppressed, Yuanqing was summoned to serve as a censor.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖改元，津亦入為御史。

translations.literal: When Jiajing began its reign, Jin also entered service as censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiajing reign, Ma Jin also entered service as a censor.

sentences.zh: 津，滁州人。

translations.literal: Jin was a man of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jin was a native of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 終福建副使。

translations.literal: He ended as vice commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as vice commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 源清尋遷大理丞，謝病歸。

translations.literal: Yuanqing soon was transferred to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review and retired on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing was soon promoted to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, then retired citing illness.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，以右僉都御史巡撫宣府。

translations.literal: In the sixth year's summer, as Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he became grand coordinator of Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jiajing year 6, he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 滴水崖賊郭春據城叛，稱王。

translations.literal: The Dingshui Cliff bandit Guo Chun seized the city in rebellion and proclaimed himself king.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Guo Chun of Dingshui Cliff seized a city in revolt and declared himself king.

sentences.zh: 源清遣卒捕之，為所覺。

translations.literal: Yuanqing sent soldiers to capture him; they were detected.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing sent soldiers to capture him, but the operation was discovered.

sentences.zh: 副總兵劉淵令曰「止擒元惡」，以旗繞城而呼。

translations.literal: Vice Regional Commander Liu Yuan ordered "capture only the chief villain" and with banners circled the city calling out.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Regional Commander Liu Yuan issued an order to "capture the ringleader only" and, banners unfurled, rode around the city calling out the terms.

sentences.zh: 其黨皆散，春等自剄死。

translations.literal: His partisans all dispersed; Chun and others cut their own throats and died.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chun's followers scattered; Guo and his associates slit their own throats.

sentences.zh: 總兵官郤永虐下，源清劾罷之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Xi Yong abused his subordinates; Yuanqing impeached and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Xi Yong abused his subordinates; Yuanqing impeached him and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 進副都御史。

translations.literal: Promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以邊警遷兵部左侍郎，總制宣、大、山西、保定諸鎮軍務。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, because of frontier alarm he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of War, with overall command of the military affairs of the garrisons of Xuan, Da, Shanxi, and Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 12, amid frontier emergencies, he was appointed Left Vice Minister of War with overall command of the garrisons of Xuanfu, Datong, Shanxi, and Baoding.

sentences.zh: 大同總兵官李瑾浚天城左孤店濠四十里，趣工急。

translations.literal: Datong Regional Commander Li Jin dredged a moat forty li at Zuogudian in Tiancheng, pressing the work urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Regional Commander Li Jin ordered a forty-li moat dug at Zuogudian in Tiancheng and drove the labor relentlessly.

sentences.zh: 卒王福勝等焚殺瑾，因焚巡撫潘亻放署。

translations.literal: Soldiers Wang Fusheng and others burned and killed Jin, and thereby burned Grand Coordinator Pan Fang's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers Wang Fusheng and others killed Li Jin by fire and burned the yamen of Grand Coordinator Pan Fang.

sentences.zh: 亻放奏瑾激變，帝命源清同總兵郤永討之。

translations.literal: Fang memorialized that Jin had provoked the mutiny; the emperor ordered Yuanqing together with Regional Commander Xi Yong to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Fang memorialized that Li Jin had provoked the mutiny; the emperor ordered Yuanqing and Regional Commander Xi Yong to suppress it.

sentences.zh: 源清榜令解散。

translations.literal: Yuanqing posted a proclamation ordering dissolution.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing issued a proclamation ordering the mutineers to disband.

sentences.zh: 而榜言五堡變，處之過寬，五堡遺孽大懼。

translations.literal: But the proclamation spoke of the Five Forts mutiny as treated too leniently; the surviving malcontents of the Five Forts were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: But the proclamation cited the earlier Five Forts mutiny as having been treated too leniently, and the surviving mutineers were seized with terror.

sentences.zh: 師次陽和，亻放等密捕亂卒杖死十餘人，系賊首王保等七十餘人以獻，請旋師。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Yanghe, Fang and others secretly captured mutinous soldiers and beat more than ten to death, bound ringleader Wang Bao and more than seventy others to present, and requested withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the army encamped at Yanghe, Pan Fang and others secretly arrested mutineers and beat more than ten to death, delivered more than seventy ringleaders including Wang Bao in bonds, and petitioned to withdraw the troops.

sentences.zh: 源清懲昔胡瓚事，不欲已，以囚屬御史蘇祐。

translations.literal: Yuanqing, chastened by the former Hu Zan affair, did not wish to stop; he handed the prisoners over to Censor Su You.
translations.idiomatic: Still mindful of the earlier debacle involving Hu Zan, Yuanqing refused to stand down and turned the prisoners over to Censor Su You.

sentences.zh: 囚妄言前總兵硃振失職首亂，且多引無辜。

translations.literal: The prisoners falsely claimed the former regional commander Zhu Zhen had failed in duty and first incited the mutiny, and moreover implicated many innocents.
translations.idiomatic: Under interrogation the prisoners falsely claimed that former Regional Commander Zhu Zhen had failed in duty and sparked the mutiny, implicating many innocent men besides.

sentences.zh: 源清遣參將趙綱入城大索。

translations.literal: Yuanqing sent Regional Vice Commander Zhao Gang into the city for a great search.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing sent Regional Vice Commander Zhao Gang into the city on a sweeping manhunt.

sentences.zh: 城中訛言城且屠，亂卒遂鼓噪，殺千戶張欽。

translations.literal: Within the city a rumor spread that the city would soon be massacred; mutinous soldiers then raised a clamor and killed Thousand-Commander Zhang Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors swept the city that a general massacre was imminent; the mutineers rose in uproar and killed Thousand-Commander Zhang Qin.

sentences.zh: 會僉事孫允中自源清所至，諭源清意，撫慰之始定。

translations.literal: It happened that Vice Commissioner Sun Yunzhong came from Yuanqing's camp, explained Yuanqing's intent, and after pacifying them they at last settled.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Sun Yunzhong arrived from Yuanqing's headquarters, explained Yuanqing's intent, and only after his reassurances did the city quiet down.

sentences.zh: 振前為亂卒所擁，實不反，詣源清自明。

translations.literal: Zhen had earlier been coerced by mutinous soldiers and in truth had not rebelled; he went to Yuanqing to clear himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Zhen had been coerced by the mutineers and had never truly rebelled; he went to Yuanqing to clear his name.

sentences.zh: 不能白，發憤自殺。

translations.literal: He could not be cleared; in fury he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to clear his name, he killed himself in despair.

sentences.zh: 永兵至城下大掠，五堡遺孽遂盡反。

translations.literal: Yong's troops reached beneath the city walls and plundered greatly; the surviving malcontents of the Five Forts then all rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Xi Yong's army arrived at the walls and looted the city, the surviving mutineers from the Five Forts rose in full revolt.

sentences.zh: 迎戰，殺遊擊曹安。

translations.literal: They met the attack in battle and killed Mobile Commander Cao An.
translations.idiomatic: They gave battle and killed Mobile Commander Cao An.

sentences.zh: 官軍攻據四關，晝夜圍擊。

translations.literal: Government troops attacked and seized the four passes, besieging and striking day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Government forces stormed and held the four passes, pressing the siege around the clock.

sentences.zh: 亂卒出前參將黃鎮等於獄，奉為帥，死守。

translations.literal: Mutinous soldiers released former Regional Commander Huang Zhen and others from prison, made them commanders, and held the city to the death.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers freed former Regional Commander Huang Zhen and others from jail, proclaimed them leaders, and prepared to die defending the city.

sentences.zh: 亻放與鎮國將軍俊郐隱等登城，止毋攻。

translations.literal: Fang and State-maintaining General Jun Yin and others mounted the wall and called for the attack to cease.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Fang, State-maintaining General Jun Yin, and others went up on the walls and urged that the assault be halted.

sentences.zh: 俊郐隱出見永請緩兵，皆不聽。

translations.literal: Jun Yin went out to see Yong and asked that troops be eased; none would listen.
translations.idiomatic: Jun Yin went out to meet Xi Yong and begged for a respite in the fighting, but his pleas went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 允中縋城出，言將士妄殺狀。

translations.literal: Yunzhong was lowered by rope from the wall and reported how the officers and soldiers had killed indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yunzhong was let down from the wall by rope and reported the indiscriminate killings by the troops.

sentences.zh: 源清叱曰：「汝為賊遊說耶！

translations.literal: Yuanqing shouted, "Are you pleading the rebels' case!
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing rebuked him: "Are you acting as the rebels' advocate?

sentences.zh: 」欲囚之。

translations.literal: " He wished to imprison him.
translations.idiomatic: " He meant to have him arrested.

sentences.zh: 允中不敢歸。

translations.literal: Yunzhong did not dare return.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yunzhong did not dare go back inside the city.

sentences.zh: 源清因多設邏卒，遏王府及有司軍民章疏，而請益師至五萬。

translations.literal: Yuanqing therefore posted many patrol guards, blocked memorials from the princely residence and from civil and military officials and the people, and requested reinforcements of up to fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing then posted extra patrols to intercept memorials from the princely residence and from officials and civilians alike, and asked that reinforcements be raised to fifty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 帝命侍郎錢如京、都督江桓統京軍八千以往。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Vice Minister Qian Rujing and Commissioner Jiang Huan to lead eight thousand capital troops thither.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Vice Minister Qian Rujing and Commissioner Jiang Huan to lead eight thousand capital troops to the scene.

sentences.zh: 已忽悟，罷弗遣，專責源清、永討賊。

translations.literal: Then he suddenly realized his error, canceled the dispatch, and charged Yuanqing and Yong alone with suppressing the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He soon thought better of it, canceled the deployment, and held Yuanqing and Xi Yong solely responsible for putting down the mutiny.

sentences.zh: 亻放馳疏言，將士妄殺激變，速旋師，亂中已。

translations.literal: Fang rushed a memorial saying that officers and soldiers had killed indiscriminately and provoked the mutiny; withdraw the army swiftly and the disorder could end.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Fang sent an urgent memorial stating that indiscriminate killings by the troops had provoked the revolt, and urging a swift withdrawal of the army so the disorder might be ended.

sentences.zh: 源清亦詆亻放媚賊。

translations.literal: Yuanqing also denounced Fang as currying favor with the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing in turn denounced Pan Fang for appeasing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 張孚敬主源清，侍郎顧鼎臣、黃綰言用兵謬，帝不能決。

translations.literal: Zhang Fuyi backed Yuanqing; Vice Ministers Gu Dingchen and Huang Wan said the use of troops was mistaken; the emperor could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fuyi sided with Yuanqing, while Vice Ministers Gu Dingchen and Huang Wan argued that military action was misguided, and the emperor could not make up his mind.

sentences.zh: 城圍久大困，毀王府及諸廨舍供爨。

translations.literal: The siege dragged on and hardship grew severe; they tore down the princely residence and various offices for firewood.
translations.idiomatic: As the siege wore on, the city fell into desperate straits, and the mutineers demolished the princely residence and government buildings for fuel.

sentences.zh: 兵部復下安撫令，源清亦樹幟招降，叛卒稍稍自投。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War again issued orders of pacification; Yuanqing also raised banners to summon surrender, and rebel soldiers gradually came in of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War issued fresh pacification orders, and Yuanqing also raised surrender banners; mutineers began trickling in one by one.

sentences.zh: 首惡黃鎮等亦分日出見，乞通樵采路，永許諾。

translations.literal: Ringleaders Huang Zhen and others also came out on successive days, begging that a path for firewood-gathering be opened; Yong promised.
translations.idiomatic: The ringleader Huang Zhen and others also came out on successive days, asking that woodcutters be allowed to pass in and out, and Xi Yong agreed.

sentences.zh: 翌日采薪者出，永悉執之。

translations.literal: The next day those gathering firewood went out, and Yong seized them all.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, when woodcutters went out, Xi Yong had them all arrested.

sentences.zh: 城中人益懼，亂卒復叛，勾外寇為助。

translations.literal: People in the city grew more fearful; mutinous soldiers rebelled again and summoned outside raiders as allies.
translations.idiomatic: Terror spread through the city; the mutineers rebelled again and called in outside raiders for help.

sentences.zh: 永遇之，大敗而遁。

translations.literal: Yong met them, suffered a great defeat, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Yong met them in battle, was routed, and fled.

sentences.zh: 叛卒遂引寇十餘騎入城，指代府曰：「以此為那顏居。

translations.literal: The rebel soldiers then led more than ten raiders into the city, pointed at the residence of the Prince of Dai, and said, "Let this be the nayan's dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: The mutineers then brought more than ten raider horsemen into the city, pointed at the residence of the Prince of Dai, and said, "This shall be the nayan's dwelling.

sentences.zh: 」「那顏」者，華言大人也。

translations.literal: " "Nayan" is the Chinese for "great man."
translations.idiomatic: " "Nayan" means "great lord" in Chinese.

sentences.zh: 城中人聞之，皆巷哭。

translations.literal: When people in the city heard this, all wept in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: When the townspeople heard this, they wept in the streets.

sentences.zh: 明日，外寇攻東南二關，叛卒與犄角，官軍殊死戰，互有殺傷。

translations.literal: The next day outside raiders attacked the two southeastern passes; rebel soldiers coordinated from another angle; government troops fought to the death, and each side inflicted casualties.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the outside raiders attacked the two southeastern passes while the mutineers struck from another angle; government troops fought desperately, and both sides suffered losses.

sentences.zh: 寇知叛卒不足賴，倒戈擊之，大詬而去。

translations.literal: The raiders knew the rebel soldiers were not to be relied upon, turned their blades against them, cursed them bitterly, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the mutineers unreliable, the raiders turned on them, cursed them roundly, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是時，寇游騎南掠至朔、應。

translations.literal: At this time raider scouting horsemen plundered south as far as Shuo and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the raiders' scouting horsemen swept south as far as Shuo and Ying.

sentences.zh: 源清請募九邊兵，增總制官禦之，己得一意攻城，帝不許。

translations.literal: Yuanqing asked to recruit troops from the Nine Frontiers and add a general-in-chief to repel them, so that he himself could concentrate on storming the city; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing asked to raise troops from the nine frontier garrisons and appoint an additional overall commander to hold them off so that he could devote himself to the siege, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 源清乃百道攻，穴城，為毒煙熏死者相籍。

translations.literal: Yuanqing then attacked from a hundred directions, tunneled into the city, and those who died from poisonous smoke lay piled upon one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing then assaulted from every direction, dug tunnels under the walls, and the dead from poisonous smoke lay heaped together.

sentences.zh: 復請壅水灌之。

translations.literal: He again asked to dam water and flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: He again petitioned to dam the water and flood the city.

sentences.zh: 帝大不懌，奪其職閑住，以兵部侍郎張瓚代之。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly displeased, stripped him of office and ordered him to live in retirement, and replaced him with Vice Minister of War Zhang Zan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply displeased, dismissed him from office to live in retirement, and replaced him with Vice Minister of War Zhang Zan.

sentences.zh: 瓚未至，郎中詹榮等已悉捕首惡。

translations.literal: Before Zan arrived, Director Jin Rong and others had already captured all the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: Before Zhang Zan arrived, Director Jin Rong and others had already seized all the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 黃綰勘功罪，言源清、永實罪魁，具劾其婪賄不貲狀。

translations.literal: Huang Wan assessed merit and guilt, saying Yuanqing and Yong were the true ringleaders, and fully impeached them for grasping bribes beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wan reviewed merits and faults, declared Yuanqing and Xi Yong the true culprits, and impeached them in detail for extortionate bribery.

sentences.zh: 兵科曾忭等言，宸濠亂，源清有保障功，當蒙八議之貸。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zeng Bian and others said that in the Prince of Ning rebellion Yuanqing had merit in defending the region and ought to receive the leniency of the Eight Deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Zeng Bian and others argued that during the Prince of Ning rebellion Yuanqing had distinguished himself in defense and deserved the leniency afforded by the Eight Deliberations.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，下忭等詔獄，逮源清治之。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry, sent Bian and the others to the imperial prison, and had Yuanqing arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged, imprisoned Zeng Bian and his colleagues, and had Yuanqing arrested and prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 獄久不決，綰憂去，乃減死，斥為民。

translations.literal: The case long went unresolved; Wan left in distress; then the sentence was reduced from death, and he was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The case dragged on without resolution; after Huang Wan withdrew in distress, the sentence was commuted from death and Yuanqing was banished as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 俺答薄京師，即家起之，未赴而卒。

translations.literal: When Altan approached the capital, he was summoned from home to office, but died before he could take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan Khan threatened the capital, Yuanqing was recalled from retirement, but died before he could report for duty.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，贈兵部尚書。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing, he was posthumously made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Longqing reign, he was posthumously appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 劉天和，字養和，麻城人。

translations.literal: Liu Tianhe, styled Yanghe, was a man of Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tianhe, styled Yanghe, came from Macheng.

sentences.zh: 正德三年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the third year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengde year 3.

sentences.zh: 授南京禮部主事。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾黜御史十八人，改他曹二十四人補之，天和與焉。

translations.literal: Liu Jin dismissed eighteen censors and transferred twenty-four men from other offices to fill the posts; Tianhe was among them.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Jin dismissed eighteen censors and filled their posts with twenty-four men transferred from other offices, Tianhe was among the replacements.

sentences.zh: 出按陝西。

translations.literal: He went out as investigating censor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as investigating censor in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 鎮守中官廖堂奉詔辦食禦物於蘭州，天和謂非所部，辭不往。

translations.literal: The eunuch defender-in-chief Liao Tang was ordered by imperial edict to procure food and tribute goods at Lanzhou; Tianhe said this was not within his jurisdiction and declined to go.
translations.idiomatic: When the eunuch frontier commander Liao Tang was ordered to procure food and tribute goods at Lanzhou, Tianhe held that this lay outside his jurisdiction and refused to go.

sentences.zh: 堂奏天和拒命，詔逮之。

translations.literal: Tang memorialized that Tianhe had defied orders; an edict ordered his arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Tang memorialized that Tianhe had defied orders, and an imperial edict ordered his arrest.

sentences.zh: 部民哭送者萬人。

translations.literal: Ten thousand people of the province wept as they saw him off.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand local people wept as they escorted him away.

sentences.zh: 錮詔獄久不釋，吏部尚書楊一清疏救，法司奏當贖杖還職，中旨謫金壇丞。

translations.literal: Confined in the imperial prison for a long time without release, Minister of Personnel Yang Yiqing submitted a memorial in his defense; the judicial offices reported that he should pay a fine, accept the rod, and return to office, but an imperial rescript demoted him to assistant magistrate of Jintan.
translations.idiomatic: Held long in the imperial prison, he was defended in a memorial by Minister of Personnel Yang Yiqing; the judicial offices recommended a fine and caning followed by reinstatement, but an imperial rescript instead demoted him to assistant magistrate of Jintan.

sentences.zh: 刑部主事孫繼芳抗章救，不報。

translations.literal: Secretary Sun Jifang of the Ministry of Punishments submitted a forceful memorial in his defense; there was no response.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jifang, a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments, submitted an urgent memorial in his defense, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 屢遷湖州知府，多惠政。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he became prefect of Huzhou, where he enacted many benevolent policies.
translations.idiomatic: After several promotions he became prefect of Huzhou, where he carried out many policies that benefited the people.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，擢山西提學副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing he was promoted to Vice Commissioner for Education in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jiajing reign he was promoted to Vice Commissioner for Education in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 累遷南京太常少卿。

translations.literal: By successive promotions he became Vice Director of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Vice Director of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 以右僉都御史督甘肅屯政。

translations.literal: As Vice Censor-in-Chief he supervised agricultural colonization in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: As Vice Censor-in-Chief he oversaw military colonization in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 請以肅州丁壯及山、陝流民于近邊耕牧，且推行于諸邊。

translations.literal: He asked that able-bodied men of Suzhou and displaced people from Shanxi and Shaanxi be settled to farm and herd on the near frontier, and that the policy be extended to the various frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed settling able-bodied men from Suzhou and displaced people from Shanxi and Shaanxi to farm and herd along the near frontier, and extending the policy to other border regions.

sentences.zh: 尋奏當興革者十事，田利大興。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized ten measures that should be instituted or abolished, and agricultural profit greatly increased.
translations.idiomatic: He soon submitted ten recommended reforms, and frontier agriculture flourished.

sentences.zh: 改撫陝西。

translations.literal: He was transferred to grand coordinator of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as grand coordinator of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 請撤鎮守中官及罷為民患者三十余事，帝皆從之。

translations.literal: He asked to withdraw the eunuch frontier commanders and to abolish more than thirty practices harmful to the people; the emperor approved all of them.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned to remove the eunuch frontier commanders and to abolish more than thirty practices that harmed the people, and the emperor approved every proposal.

sentences.zh: 洮、岷番四十二族蠢動，天和誅不順命者。

translations.literal: Forty-two Tibetan tribes of Tao and Min stirred restlessly; Tianhe executed those who would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: When forty-two Tibetan tribes of Tao and Min grew restless, Tianhe executed those who refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 又討平湖店大盜及漢中妖賊，就進右副都御史。

translations.literal: He also suppressed the great bandits of Pinghu Store and the sorcerer-rebels of Hanzhong, and on that account was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He also suppressed the major bandits of Pinghu Store and the sorcerer rebels of Hanzhong, and was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief on that account.

sentences.zh: 母憂，服闋以故官總理河道。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death, when mourning was complete he returned to his former office to oversee the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother, he resumed his former rank and was put in charge of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 黃河南徙，曆濟、徐皆旁溢。

translations.literal: The Yellow River shifted south; through Ji and Xu it overflowed on every side.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River shifted southward, the regions of Ji and Xu were flooded on every side.

sentences.zh: 天和疏汴河，自硃仙鎮至沛飛雲橋，殺其下流。

translations.literal: Tianhe dredged the Bian River from Zhuxian Town to Feiyun Bridge in Pei, reducing its lower flow.
translations.idiomatic: Tianhe dredged the Bian River from Zhuxian Town to Feiyun Bridge in Pei, cutting back its lower course.

sentences.zh: 疏山東七十二泉，自鳧、尼諸山達南旺河，浚其下流。

translations.literal: He dredged the seventy-two springs of Shandong from Mount Fu, Mount Ni, and other mountains down to the Nanwang River, clearing their lower reaches.
translations.idiomatic: He cleared the seventy-two springs of Shandong from Mount Fu, Mount Ni, and other peaks down to the Nanwang River, dredging their lower channels.

sentences.zh: 役夫二萬，不三月訖工。

translations.literal: With twenty thousand laborers, the work was finished in less than three months.
translations.idiomatic: Using twenty thousand laborers, the work was completed in less than three months.

sentences.zh: 加工部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 故事，河南八府歲役民治河，不赴役者人出銀三兩。

translations.literal: By precedent the eight prefectures of Henan annually conscripted the people for river work; those who did not serve paid three taels of silver each.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the eight prefectures of Henan conscripted laborers each year for river work; those who did not serve paid three taels of silver apiece.

sentences.zh: 天和因歲饑，請盡蠲旁河受役者課，遠河未役者半之。

translations.literal: Because of famine that year, Tianhe asked that levies on those near the river who were liable for service be wholly remitted, and those farther from the river who had not yet served pay half.
translations.idiomatic: Because of famine that year, Tianhe asked that levies on those near the river who were liable for corvée be wholly remitted, and that those farther away who had not yet served pay half.

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the request.

sentences.zh: 十五年改兵部左侍郎，總制三邊軍務。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was made Left Vice Minister of War and given overall command of the military affairs of the Three Frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 15 he was appointed Left Vice Minister of War with overall command of the Three Frontiers.

sentences.zh: 兵車皆雙輪，用二十人，遇險即困，又行遲不適於用。

translations.literal: Military wagons all had two wheels and required twenty men; they were easily stalled in difficult terrain, and they moved slowly and were unsuited to use.
translations.idiomatic: The army wagons all had two wheels and required twenty men to move; they bogged down in rough terrain, moved too slowly, and were ill suited to campaigning.

sentences.zh: 天和請仿前總督秦紘只輪車，上置砲槍斧戟，廂前樹狻猊牌，左右虎盾，連二車可蔽三四十人。

translations.literal: Tianhe asked to follow the former overall commander Qin Hong's single-wheeled cart, mounting cannon, muskets, axes, and halberds upon it, setting suanni shields before the carriage, tiger shields to left and right, and linking two carts so that thirty or forty men could be sheltered.
translations.idiomatic: Tianhe proposed reviving the single-wheeled cart used by the former overall commander Qin Hong, mounting cannon, muskets, axes, and halberds on it, placing suanni shields before the carriage and tiger shields to either side, and linking two carts so that thirty or forty men could fight under cover.

sentences.zh: 一人挽之，推且翼者各二人。

translations.literal: One man pulled it; two men pushed and two flanked it on either side.
translations.idiomatic: One man hauled it, two pushed, and two more flanked it on each side.

sentences.zh: 戰則護騎士其中，敵遠則施火器，稍近發弓弩，又近乃出短兵，敵走則騎兵追。

translations.literal: In battle cavalry were protected within; when the enemy was far they used firearms; when somewhat nearer they shot bows and crossbows; when still nearer they drew short weapons; when the enemy fled cavalry pursued.
translations.idiomatic: In battle cavalry sheltered inside; at long range they used firearms, at medium range bows and crossbows, at close quarters short weapons, and when the enemy fled cavalry gave chase.

sentences.zh: 復製隨車小帳，令士不露宿。

translations.literal: He also made small tents carried with the carts so that soldiers need not sleep in the open.
translations.idiomatic: He also devised small tents carried with the carts so the men would not have to sleep in the open.

sentences.zh: 又毒弩矢，修邊牆濠塹。

translations.literal: He also poisoned crossbow bolts and repaired the frontier walls, moats, and trenches.
translations.idiomatic: He also poisoned crossbow bolts and repaired the frontier walls, moats, and trenches.

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All his proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 吉囊十萬眾屯賀蘭山後，遣別部寇涼州，副將王輔逐奪其纛。

translations.literal: Jicang with a hundred thousand men encamped behind Helan Mountain and sent a separate force to raid Liangzhou; Vice General Wang Fu pursued and seized their standard.
translations.idiomatic: Jicang encamped with a hundred thousand men behind Helan Mountain and sent a detachment against Liangzhou; Vice General Wang Fu pursued them and captured their battle standard.

sentences.zh: 寇莊浪，總兵官姜奭屢敗之。

translations.literal: When they raided Zhuanglang, Regional Commander Jiang Yi repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When they raided Zhuanglang, Regional Commander Jiang Yi defeated them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 進天和右都御史。

translations.literal: Tianhe was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tianhe was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 寇復大集兵將入犯。

translations.literal: The raiders again gathered their forces in strength and were about to invade.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders massed again and prepared to invade.

sentences.zh: 天和策寇瞰西有備必東，密檄延綏副將白爵宵行，與參將吳瑛合。

translations.literal: Tianhe judged that seeing defenses in the west the raiders would surely strike east; he secretly ordered Yan-Sui Vice General Bai Jue to march by night and join Regional Vice Commander Wu Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Reasoning that the raiders, finding the west well defended, would strike east, Tianhe secretly ordered Yan-Sui Vice General Bai Jue to march by night and join Regional Vice Commander Wu Ying.

sentences.zh: 寇果東入黑河墩，遇爵伏兵，大創而去。

translations.literal: The raiders indeed entered east at Heihe Dun, met Jue's ambush, suffered a heavy blow, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders did enter from the east at Heihe Dun, ran into Bai Jue's ambush, suffered heavy losses, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 既又入蒺藜川，爵尾擊之，寇多死。

translations.literal: Later they entered Jili Chuan again; Jue struck them from the rear and many raiders died.
translations.idiomatic: When they entered Jili Chuan again, Bai Jue struck from the rear and many raiders were killed.

sentences.zh: 尋入寇家澗、張家塔，為爵、瑛所敗。

translations.literal: Soon they entered and raided Jiajian and Zhangjiata; they were defeated by Jue and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: They soon raided Jiajian and Zhangjiata and were defeated by Bai Jue and Wu Ying.

sentences.zh: 犯寧夏者，總兵官王效復破之。

translations.literal: Those who invaded Ningxia were again defeated by Regional Commander Wang Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: The force that struck Ningxia was again defeated by Regional Commander Wang Xiao.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，進天和左都御史。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and promoted Tianhe to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and promoted Tianhe to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 吉囊犯河西，天和禦卻之，進兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Jicang invaded west of the river; Tianhe repelled him and was promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: When Jicang invaded west of the river, Tianhe drove him back and was promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 寇將入平虜城，天和伏兵花馬池。

translations.literal: As the raiders were about to enter Pinglu Fort, Tianhe set an ambush at Huamachi.
translations.idiomatic: As the raiders were about to enter Pinglu Fort, Tianhe laid an ambush at Huamachi.

sentences.zh: 寇戰不勝，走河上。

translations.literal: The raiders fought without victory and fled toward the river.
translations.idiomatic: The raiders were defeated in battle and fled toward the river.

sentences.zh: 遇伏兵，多死于水。

translations.literal: They met the ambush and many died in the water.
translations.idiomatic: They ran into the ambush, and many drowned.

sentences.zh: 吉囊乘虛寇固原，剽掠且饜。

translations.literal: Jicang seized the opening to raid Guyuan, plundering until sated.
translations.idiomatic: Jicang seized the opportunity to raid Guyuan and plundered to his fill.

sentences.zh: 會淫潦，弓矢盡膠，無鬥志。

translations.literal: It happened that heavy rains fell; bows and arrows were all glued up, and there was no will to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains set in, glueing up bows and arrows, and the troops lost all fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 而諸將多畏縮，天和斬指揮二人，召故總兵周尚文令立功。

translations.literal: Yet many generals shrank in fear; Tianhe executed two commanders and summoned the former regional commander Zhou Shangwen, ordering him to redeem himself with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Many of the generals hung back in fear; Tianhe executed two commanders and recalled the former regional commander Zhou Shangwen, ordering him to redeem himself in battle.

sentences.zh: 會陝西總兵官魏時角寇至黑水苑，尚文盡銳夾擊，殺吉囊子小十王。

translations.literal: It happened that Shaanxi Regional Commander Wei Shi intercepted the raiders at Heishui Yuan; Shangwen brought all his crack troops in a pincer attack and killed Jicang's son, the Little Tenth Prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaanxi Regional Commander Wei Shi intercepted the raiders at Heishui Yuan, Zhou Shangwen brought up all his crack troops in a pincer attack and killed Jicang's son, the Little Tenth Prince.

sentences.zh: 寇退寧夏，巡撫楊守禮、總兵官任傑等復邀擊，敗之鐵柱泉，斬獲共四百四十餘級。

translations.literal: The raiders retreated toward Ningxia; Grand Coordinator Yang Shouli, Regional Commander Ren Jie, and others again intercepted them, defeated them at Tiezhu Quan, and beheaded or captured more than four hundred forty in all.
translations.idiomatic: As the raiders withdrew toward Ningxia, Grand Coordinator Yang Shouli, Regional Commander Ren Jie, and others intercepted them again, defeated them at Tiezhu Quan, and took more than four hundred forty heads and captives in all.

sentences.zh: 論功，加天和太子太保，廕一子錦衣千戶，前後齎銀幣十數。

translations.literal: Assessing merit, Tianhe was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, one son was granted the hereditary post of commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and on several occasions he was awarded silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: For these achievements Tianhe was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, one son was granted a hereditary post as commander in the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and he received silver and silks on more than ten occasions.

sentences.zh: 遷南京戶部尚書，召為兵部尚書督團營。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Revenue at Nanjing, then summoned to be Minister of War and supervise the Corps Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Revenue at Nanjing, then recalled to serve as Minister of War and supervise the Corps Divisions.

sentences.zh: 言官論天和衰老，遂乞休歸。

translations.literal: Censorial officials argued that Tianhe was aged, and he thereupon asked to retire and return home.
translations.idiomatic: When censorial officials criticized him as too old for office, he requested retirement and returned home.

sentences.zh: 家居三年卒。

translations.literal: He lived at home three years and died.
translations.idiomatic: After three years at home he died.

sentences.zh: 贈少保，諡莊襄。

translations.literal: Posthumously awarded Junior Guardian, posthumous title Zhuangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded the title of Junior Guardian, with the posthumous name Zhuangxiang.

sentences.zh: 天和初舉進士，劉瑾欲與敘宗姓，謝不往。

translations.literal: When Tianhe first passed the jinshi examination, Liu Jin wished to treat him as a clansman and discuss lineage; he declined and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianhe first passed the jinshi examination, Liu Jin wished to acknowledge him as a kinsman and discuss their shared lineage, but he politely declined and would not go.

sentences.zh: 晚年內召，陶仲文以刺迎，稱戚屬。

translations.literal: In his later years when summoned to court, Tao Zhongwen welcomed him with a calling card, addressing him as a kinsman by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years, when he was summoned to court, Tao Zhongwen welcomed him with a calling card and addressed him as a kinsman by marriage.

sentences.zh: 天和返其刺曰：「誤矣，吾中外姻連無是人。

translations.literal: Tianhe returned the card and said: "You are mistaken; among my marital connections inside and outside the family there is no such person.
translations.idiomatic: Tianhe returned the card and said, "You are mistaken. Among all my marital connections, near and far, there is no such person.

sentences.zh: 」仲文恚，其罷官有力焉。

translations.literal: " Zhongwen resented this, and he had no small part in Tianhe's dismissal from office.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhongwen took offense, and he had no small part in bringing about Tianhe's dismissal from office.

sentences.zh: 楊守禮，字秉節，蒲州人。

translations.literal: Yang Shouli, styled Bingjie, was a native of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shouli, styled Bingjie, was a native of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 正德六年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi of Zhengde year 6.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengde year 6.

sentences.zh: 除戶部主事。

translations.literal: Appointed secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，屢遷湖廣僉事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing, repeatedly promoted to surveillance vice commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiajing reign he was repeatedly promoted until he became surveillance vice commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 以計擒公安賊魁。

translations.literal: By stratagem captured the bandit chieftain of Gong'an.
translations.idiomatic: By stratagem he captured the bandit chieftain of Gong'an.

sentences.zh: 坐事謫敘州通判。

translations.literal: For an offense demoted to assistant prefect of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was demoted to assistant prefect of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 累遷右副都御史，巡撫四川。

translations.literal: Through successive promotions became Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive promotions he became Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 與副將何卿平諸番亂，齎銀幣。

translations.literal: With deputy general He Qing pacified the rebellions of the various tribes and was awarded silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Together with deputy general He Qing he pacified the rebellions of the various tribes and was awarded silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 初，守禮貶敘州，為僉事張文奎所辱。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Shouli was demoted to Xuzhou, he was humiliated by surveillance vice commissioner Zhang Wenkui.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Shouli had been demoted to Xuzhou, he was humiliated by surveillance vice commissioner Zhang Wenkui.

sentences.zh: 至是，文奎遷四川參議，恐守禮修隙，先以所摭事奏。

translations.literal: At this time Wenkui was transferred to Sichuan as administration vice commissioner; fearing Shouli would settle old scores, he first memorialized with matters he had dredged up.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Wenkui was transferred to Sichuan as administration vice commissioner. Fearing that Shouli would settle old scores, he first memorialized the court with charges he had dredged up.

sentences.zh: 詔二人俱解職歸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered both men to resign their posts and return home.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered both men to resign their posts and return home.

sentences.zh: 守禮才器敏達，中外以為能。

translations.literal: Shouli was quick and capable in talent and ability; inside and outside the court he was regarded as competent.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli was quick and capable, and both inside and outside the court he was regarded as a man of talent.

sentences.zh: 居家未久，工部尚書秦金等會薦，起河南參政。

translations.literal: Not long at home, Minister of Works Qin Jin and others jointly recommended him, and he was recalled as administration commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he returned home, Minister of Works Qin Jin and others jointly recommended him, and he was recalled to serve as administration commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 再遷右副都御史，巡撫寧夏。

translations.literal: Again promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed Grand Coordinator of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 寇犯固原，為總督劉天和所敗。

translations.literal: Raiders invaded Guyuan and were defeated by Grand Coordinator Liu Tianhe.
translations.idiomatic: When raiders invaded Guyuan, they were defeated by Grand Coordinator Liu Tianhe.

sentences.zh: 欲自寧夏去，守禮與總兵任傑等邀敗之。

translations.literal: Wishing to leave from Ningxia, they were intercepted and defeated by Shouli with regional commander Ren Jie and others.
translations.idiomatic: As they tried to withdraw from Ningxia, Shouli together with regional commander Ren Jie and others intercepted and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 會天和召還，進守禮右都御史總督軍務代之。

translations.literal: When Tianhe was recalled, Shouli was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief to supervise military affairs in his place.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianhe was recalled, Shouli was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief and appointed to supervise military affairs in his place.

sentences.zh: 錄前功，進兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Recording prior merit, he was promoted to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: For his earlier achievements he was promoted to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 總兵官李義、楊信連卻吉囊，三賜璽書銀幣。

translations.literal: Regional commanders Li Yi and Yang Xin repeatedly repelled Jicang; three times imperial edicts with silver and silks were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commanders Li Yi and Yang Xin repeatedly drove back Jicang, and on three occasions imperial edicts accompanied by silver and silks were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 尋上疏乞休，帝惡其避難，降俸二級。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized begging retirement; the emperor resented him for avoiding hardship and reduced his salary by two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he memorialized requesting retirement. The emperor resented him for shirking hardship and reduced his salary by two grades.

sentences.zh: 其秋，寇三萬騎抵綏德。

translations.literal: That autumn, thirty thousand mounted raiders reached Suide.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn thirty thousand mounted raiders reached Suide.

sentences.zh: 遊擊張鵬卻之，總兵官吳英等追至塞外，東路參將周文兵亦至，夾擊敗之。

translations.literal: Mobile detachment commander Zhang Peng repelled them; regional commander Wu Ying and others pursued beyond the frontier; Eastern Route deputy commander Zhou Wen's troops also arrived; in a pincer attack they were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Mobile detachment commander Zhang Peng drove them back, regional commander Wu Ying and others pursued them beyond the frontier, and Eastern Route deputy commander Zhou Wen's troops also arrived; in a pincer attack the raiders were defeated.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史殷學言，寇入內地五百里，請治諸將罪。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Yin Xue said: "The raiders penetrated five hundred li into the interior; I request the generals be punished."
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Yin Xue argued that since the raiders had penetrated five hundred li into the interior, the generals should be punished.

sentences.zh: 部議延綏遊兵俱調宣、大，寇方避實擊虛。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated: "The mobile troops of Yan-Sui had all been transferred to Xuan-Da; the raiders were deliberately avoiding strong points to strike weak ones."
translations.idiomatic: The ministry replied that the mobile troops of Yan-Sui had all been transferred to Xuan-Da, and the raiders had deliberately avoided strong points to strike where defenses were weak.

sentences.zh: 而我能以寡勝眾，宜錄其功。

translations.literal: Yet we were able to defeat many with few; their merit should be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the commanders had defeated a larger force with fewer troops, and their merit ought to be recorded.

sentences.zh: 乃加守禮太子少保，學謫外。

translations.literal: Shouli was then made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Xue was demoted and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli was then made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, while Xue was demoted and sent away from court.

sentences.zh: 守禮尋以憂去。

translations.literal: Shouli soon left office due to mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli soon left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 俺答薄都城，廷臣首以守禮薦，詔趣上道。

translations.literal: Altan Khan approached the capital; court officials first recommended Shouli; an edict ordered him to hurry on the road.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan Khan approached the capital, court officials first recommended Shouli, and an edict ordered him to set out at once.

sentences.zh: 寇退，止不行。

translations.literal: The raiders withdrew; the order was stopped and he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: When the raiders withdrew, the summons was canceled and he did not go.

sentences.zh: 久之卒。

translations.literal: After a long time he died.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he died.

sentences.zh: 張岳，字維喬，惠安人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue, styled Weiqiao, was a native of Huian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue, styled Weiqiao, was a native of Huian.

sentences.zh: 自幼好學，以大儒自期。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning and expected himself to become a great Confucian scholar.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved learning and set his sights on becoming a great Confucian scholar.

sentences.zh: 登正德十一年進士，授行人。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi examination in Zhengde year 11; appointed courier.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengde year 11 and was appointed a courier.

sentences.zh: 武宗寢疾豹房。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong lay ill in the Leopard Quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong lay ill in the Leopard Quarter.

sentences.zh: 請令大臣侍從，台諫輪直起居，視藥餌，防意外變。

translations.literal: He requested that grand ministers attend, censorial officials rotate in watching daily rise and sleep, inspect medicines, and guard against unexpected change.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that grand ministers attend the emperor, that censorial officials take turns watching over his daily routine, inspect his medicines, and guard against any unexpected turn of events.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No response.
translations.idiomatic: There was no response.

sentences.zh: 與同官諫南巡，杖闕下，謫南京國子學正。

translations.literal: With fellow officials he remonstrated against the southern tour; was beaten at the palace gate; demoted to director of studies at the Nanjing Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Together with fellow officials he remonstrated against the southern tour, was beaten at the palace gate, and was demoted to director of studies at the Nanjing Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣位，復故官，遷右司副。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong succeeded to the throne, he was restored to his former post and promoted to Right Bureau Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong succeeded to the throne, Yue was restored to his former post and promoted to Right Bureau Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 母老乞便養，改南京武選員外郎，曆主客郎中。

translations.literal: His mother was aged and he requested convenient care; he was transferred to vice director of Military Appointments at Nanjing and served successively as bureau director of Receptions.
translations.idiomatic: Because his mother was aged, he requested a convenient post so he could care for her; he was transferred to vice director of Military Appointments at Nanjing and later served as bureau director of Receptions.

sentences.zh: 方議大禘禮。

translations.literal: Just then the Grand Sacrifice rite was under discussion.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court was debating the Grand Sacrifice rite.

sentences.zh: 張璁求始祖所自出者實之，禮官皆唯唯。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong sought to identify and substantiate the founder's actual progenitor; ritual officials all assented vaguely.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong sought to identify and substantiate the emperor's actual founding ancestor, and the ritual officials all murmured their assent.

sentences.zh: 岳言于尚書李時曰：「不如為皇初祖位，毋實以人。

translations.literal: Yue said to Minister Li Shi: "Better to make a place for the Imperial Primordial Ancestor, without substantiating it with a person.
